title.en: HK 'ready to show unique strengths in Apec summits'
title.zh: 香港准备在亚太经合组织峰会上展示独特优势

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive, John Lee, stated that the city is prepared to showcase its unique strengths, including its rule of law, free-flowing capital, and global financial influence, as the Greater Bay Area prepares to host Apec leaders for the first time in November. Hong Kong will host the Apec Finance...
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超表示，香港已准备好展示其独特的优势，包括法治、资本自由流动和全球金融影响力，因为大湾区将在11月首次迎来亚太经合组织领导人。香港将于10月主办亚太经合组织财长会议，而深圳将主办亚太经合组织经济领导人会议。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee said Hong Kong's rule of law, free-flowing capital and global financial heft take on new weight as the Greater Bay Area (GBA) prepares to welcome Apec leaders for the first time this November. Delivering a video speech at the Greater Bay Area Conference on Thursday, he said the upcoming summits will put the region in the global spotlight like never before. "The spotlight is on our region. And we are ready," Lee said, noting that Shenzhen will host the Apec Economic Leaders' Meeting while Hong Kong will host the Apec Finance Ministers' Meeting in October. He framed Hong Kong's role as unique and irreplaceable, supported by the advantages of operating under the "One Country, Two Systems" principle. "Hong Kong is the only world city that converges both the China advantage and the global advantage," Lee said. "We offer a highly market-oriented environment, anchored in the rule of law. We maintain a common law system. "Capital, information and talent flow freely. Our tax regime is simple and low, backed by world-class professional services. "Taken together, these strengths make Hong Kong a gateway connecting the mainland and global markets." Lee added that Hong Kong brings together ideas, capital and talent across boundaries, and connects the Greater Bay Area with global markets. Echoing that vision, Financial Secretary Paul Chan in his video speech said the Greater Bay Area stands apart as "unique in the world" – a single region bringing together a leading international financial centre, one of the world's most dynamic innovation clusters, advanced manufacturing at scale, and a multimodal transport network. "As the country's most internationally connected region, the GBA presents a strong value proposition for Asia-Pacific collaboration," he said. "It rests on a simple conviction: when we partner, we do not merely add up our strengths – we multiply them, and extend their reach well beyond Asia." Chan pointed to embodied intelligence – AI integrated into physical systems – as a prime example of that multiplying power. Hong Kong offers world-class AI research and international reach, he said, while Shenzhen provides a robotics supply chain where "most components are within half an hour's drive". That proximity, he said, allows ideas to move seamlessly from prototype to testing, mass production and global markets. Chan framed the year-end Apec gatherings as a pivotal opportunity for the Greater Bay Area to act as a vital link, driving dialogue, deepening cooperation, and forging new partnerships. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李家超表示，随着大湾区准备在今年 11 月首次欢迎亚太经合组织领导人，香港的法治、资本自由流动和全球金融影响力将获得新的重视。他周四在大湾区会议上发表视频讲话，表示即将举行的峰会将使该地区前所未有地受到全球关注。李说：“焦点集中在我们的地区。我们已经准备好了。”他指出，深圳将主办亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议，香港将主办十月份的亚太经合组织财长会议。他认为，在“一国两制”原则下运作的优势支持下，香港的作用是独特且不可替代的。李说：“香港是唯一融合中国优势和全球优势的世界城市。” “我们提供高度市场化的环境，以法治为基础。我们维持普通法体系。”资本、信息和人才自由流动。我们的税制简单且低，并以世界一流的专业服务为后盾。 “总而言之，这些优势使香港成为连接内地和全球市场的门户。”李补充说，香港跨境汇聚创意、资本和人才，连接大湾区与全球市场。财政司司长陈茂波在视频讲话中呼应这一愿景，表示大湾区“在世界上独一无二”——一个汇集了领先的国际金融中心、全球最具活力的创新集群之一、大规模先进制造业和多式联运网络的单一地区。他表示：“作为中国国际联系最紧密的地区，大湾区为亚太合作提供了强有力的价值主张。” “它基于一个简单的信念：当我们合作时，我们不仅仅是将我们的优势相加，而是将它们倍增，并将其影响力远远扩展到亚洲以外。”陈指出，体现智能——人工智能集成到物理系统中——是这种倍增能力的一个典型例子。他说，香港提供世界一流的人工智能研究和国际影响力，而深圳则提供机器人供应链，“大多数组件都在半小时车程内”。他说，这种接近使得想法可以从原型无缝转移到测试、大规模生产和全球市场。陈肇始将亚太经合组织年终会议视为大湾区发挥重要纽带作用的重要机遇，推动对话、深化合作、建立新伙伴关系。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong prepares to host significant international meetings, its leaders emphasize the city's established systems of governance and finance. This focus on the structures that enable order and economic activity resonates with the biblical principle that governing authorities are instituted by God for the common good. The city's role in facilitating...
reflection.zh: 随着香港准备主办重要的国际会议，其领导人强调了该市既有的治理和金融体系。这种对促进秩序和经济活动的结构的关注，与治理当局由雅伟设立以促进共同福祉的圣经原则产生了共鸣。该市在促进全球对话和商业方面的作用，可以看作是稳定机构重要性的证明。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: Schools, ferry routes suspended as Typhoon Saudel lashes east China
title.zh: 台风“灿都”袭击华东，学校和渡轮航线停运

summary.en: Authorities in China's Fujian province closed schools and suspended ferry services on Thursday as Typhoon Saudel approached, bringing warnings of heavy rain. This follows a pattern of extreme weather events in China over recent months, which have included torrential rainfall and mass evacuations.
summary.zh: 周四，中国福建省当局关闭学校并暂停渡轮服务，因为台风“灿都”来袭并带来强降雨预警。这与近几个月来中国极端天气事件频发的模式一致，包括暴雨和大规模疏散。

body.en: Authorities closed schools and suspended ferry routes in eastern China’s Fujian province on Thursday, after forecasters warned of heavy rain brought about by Typhoon Saudel. A satellite view of Typhoon Saudel making landfall on China’s eastern coast on August 28, 2026. Photo: CSU/CIRA & JMA/JAXA. Extreme weather has wreaked havoc in parts of China during the past few months, with a slew of typhoons bringing torrential rainfall and triggering the evacuation of hundreds of thousands of people. Typhoon Saudel made its third landfall in China on Fujian’s coast on Thursday morning, according to local authorities, after earlier lashing neighbouring Zhejiang province twice. Schools in the cities of Fuzhou and Quanzhou halted in-person activities, while some tourist attractions including theme parks were also temporarily closed in Fuzhou, local media outlets reported. A total of 24 passenger ferry routes along the coast of Fujian were suspended on Thursday, state broadcaster CCTV reported. The province’s emergency management authority warned of rainstorms and secondary disasters including flash floods and landslides. “The province is currently experiencing a period of persistent, heavy rainfall,” it said in a WeChat statement. Around 247,700 people in high-risk areas in neighbouring Fujian had been evacuated last week, after authorities had warned of heavy rain, Xinhua news agency reported. At least 159 people were killed in southern China’s Guangxi region in July after Typhoon Maysak triggered devastating floods. Scientists warn the intensity and frequency of extreme weather events will increase as the planet continues to heat up because of fossil fuel emissions. China is the world’s biggest emitter of greenhouse gases, but it is also a global renewable energy powerhouse that aims to make its massive economy carbon-neutral by 2060. A catastrophic flood sliced through the border area between Nepal and China’s Tibet region last week, killing more than 1,200 people and leaving more than 4,750 missing as of Thursday, heightening concerns globally over the growing risks of climate change.
body.zh: 在预报员警告台风“萨德尔”带来大雨后，中国东部福建省周四关闭了学校并暂停了轮渡航线。 2026 年 8 月 28 日台风“萨德尔”登陆中国东部沿海的卫星图。照片：CSU/CIRA & JMA/JAXA。过去几个月，极端天气给中国部分地区造成严重破坏，一系列台风带来暴雨，导致数十万人撤离。据地方当局称，台风“萨德尔”周四上午在中国福建沿海第三次登陆，此前该台风曾两次袭击邻近的浙江省。据当地媒体报道，福州和泉州两市的学校停止了线下活动，福州主题公园等一些旅游景点也暂时关闭。据中央电视台报道，周四福建沿海共有 24 条客运轮渡航线暂停。该省应急管理部门警告称，可能会出现暴雨和山洪、山体滑坡等次生灾害。该省在微信声明中表示：“目前，我省正经历持续强降雨时期。”据新华社报道，上周当局发出大雨警告后，邻国福建高风险地区约 247,700 人被疏散。 7 月，台风美莎克引发特大洪水，造成中国南部广西地区至少 159 人死亡。科学家警告说，随着化石燃料排放导致地球持续升温，极端天气事件的强度和频率将会增加。中国是世界上最大的温室气体排放国，但它也是全球可再生能源大国，目标是到2060年使其庞大的经济实现碳中和。上周，一场灾难性洪水席卷了尼泊尔和中国西藏地区之间的边境地区，截至周四，造成1,200多人死亡，4,750多人失踪，加剧了全球对日益增长的气候变化风险的担忧。

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's approach forced the closure of schools and suspension of ferry routes in Fujian province, disrupting daily life. In times of natural disaster, when familiar routines are overturned and safety is uncertain, we can remember that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. Even amidst the chaos of storms, there is a...
reflection.zh: 台风“灿都”的逼近迫使福建省关闭学校并暂停渡轮服务，扰乱了日常生活。在自然灾害时期，当熟悉的日常被打乱，安全变得不确定时，我们可以铭记雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。即使在风暴的混乱中，也存在着坚定的盼望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Hong Kong court upholds convictions of Cardinal Joseph Zen, trustees of 2019 protester relief fund
title.zh: 香港法院维持对陈日君枢机及2019年抗议者援助基金受托人定罪的裁决

summary.en: A Hong Kong court has upheld the convictions of Cardinal Joseph Zen and four other individuals for failing to properly register a fund that provided support to protesters during the 2019 unrest. The Court of Appeal dismissed their challenge, affirming the original ruling against the trustees of the now-defunct 612...
summary.zh: 香港法院维持了对陈日君枢机及另外四名人士的定罪裁决，他们因未能妥善注册一个曾为2019年抗议者提供援助的基金而受到指控。上诉法院驳回了他们的上诉，确认了对该已解散的“612人道支援基金”受托人的原判。

body.en: A Hong Kong court has upheld the convictions of Cardinal Joseph Zen and four other appellants over failing to properly register their now-defunct fund that supported protesters during the 2019 protests and unrest. Cardinal Joseph Zen (centre) appears at the High Court alongside, from left, scholar Hui Po-keung, barrister Margaret Ng, ex-lawmaker Cyd Ho, and singer-activist Denise Ho, on September 3, 2026. Photo: Hans Tse/HKFP. The Court of Appeal on Thursday dismissed the bid by Cardinal Zen, barrister Margaret Ng, former lawmaker Cyd Ho, scholar Hui Po-keung, and singer-activist Denise Ho, who were trustees of the since-disbanded 612 Humanitarian Relief Fund . The five pro-democracy figures were found guilty in November 2022 of not registering their fund as a society under the city’s Societies Ordinance, and were each fined HK$4,000 by the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts. They launched an appeal against the conviction, arguing that the fund was established as a trust rather than a society. They also argued that the ruling implied nearly all groups holding activities must be registered as societies, infringing upon the freedom of association. In a judgment handed down on Thursday, three Court of Appeal judges sided with the lower court in finding that the 612 fund was indeed a society, and therefore it had to apply for registration or an exemption under the law. The Court of Final Appeal. File photo: GovHK. “We find that the appellants had all along intended to use the Fund as a vehicle to appeal for, collect and apply public donations for the purpose of supporting” the 2019 protests, wrote Chief Judge of the High Court Jeremy Poon. “The Fund is more than ‘a mere sum of moneys held by the appellants on trust.'” The judges also ruled that the five had conducted and managed the fund’s operations “like a management committee or governing body” under an agreed-upon trust deed. “In so conducting the affairs of the Fund, they were its office-bearers as a society, quite apart from their role [as] trustees,“ the judgment added. Final appeal bid planned Ng, also a former lawmaker, said on Thursday that the five would seek to take their case to the apex Court of Final Appeal, after briefly meeting with lawyers following the judgment. “This case is not only about the 612 fund – rather, it concerns the Societies Ordinance,” Ng told reporters in Cantonese. “If whenever a group of people come together to do something it becomes a society that must apply for registration or an exemption with the police, this would have a huge impact on Hong Kong civil society,” she said. (From left) Cyd Ho, Cardinal Joseph Zen, Margaret Ng, Denise Ho and Hui Po-keung, the former trustees of the 612...
body.zh: 香港一家法院维持了枢机主教陈日君和其他四名上诉人的定罪，因为他们未能正确登记他们在 2019 年抗议和骚乱期间支持抗议者的基金，该基金现已不复存在。 2026 年 9 月 3 日，枢机主教陈日君（中）出现在高等法院，旁边是学者许宝强、大律师吴霭仪、前立法会议员何秀兰和歌手兼活动家何韵诗。照片：Hans Tse/HKFP。上诉法院周四驳回了陈枢机主教、大律师吴霭仪、前立法会议员何秀兰、学者许宝强和歌手兼活动家何韵诗的申请，他们是已解散的612人道主义救济基金的受托人。 2022年11月，这五名民主人士因未根据香港《社团条例》将其基金注册为社团而被西九龙裁判法院裁定罪名成立，每人被罚款港币4,000元。他们对定罪提出上诉，认为该基金是作为信托而不是协会而设立的。他们还认为，该裁决意味着几乎所有开展活动的团体都必须注册为社团，侵犯了结社自由。在周四作出的判决中，三名上诉法院法官站在下级法院一边，认为612基金确实是一个社团，因此必须依法申请注册或豁免。终审法院。资料图片：香港政府一站通。高等法院首席法官潘杰里米写道，“我们发现上诉人一直打算利用该基金作为呼吁、收集和运用公众捐款的工具，以支持”2019年的抗议活动。 “该基金不仅仅是‘上诉人以信托方式持有的一笔资金’。”法官还裁定，五人“像管理委员会或理事机构一样”根据商定的信托契约进行和管理该基金的运营。判决补充说：“在处理基金事务时，他们是基金作为一个社会的负责人，而不仅仅是受托人的角色。”计划进行最终上诉的吴恩达周四表示，五人在判决后与律师短暂会面后，将寻求将案件提交至终审法院。 “这个案件不仅涉及612基金，而且还涉及《社团条例》，”吴用粤语告诉记者。她说：“如果每当一群人聚集在一起做某件事时，就成为一个必须向警方申请注册或豁免的社团，这将对香港民间社会产生巨大影响。” （左起）612前受托人何秀兰、陈日君枢机、吴霭仪、何韵诗和许宝强...

reflection.en: The legal system grapples with accountability for actions taken during times of civil unrest. While the court has upheld the convictions related to the registration of the 612 Humanitarian Relief Fund, the case brings to mind the enduring call to "act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." This principle reminds us to seek fairness and...
reflection.zh: 法律体系正在处理 civil unrest 时期行为的问责问题。尽管法院维持了与“612人道支援基金”注册相关的定罪，但此案令人想起那句永恒的呼召：“只当公义行事，喜爱怜悯，谦卑与你的神同行。”这一原则提醒我们在所有审判中寻求公正与怜悯，尤其是在处理社会运动复杂后果之时。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Palau urges ‘unified’ Pacific response to China’s intercontinental ballistic test
title.zh: 帕劳敦促太平洋国家对中国洲际弹道导弹试验做出‘统一’回应

summary.en: Palau's president urged a unified Pacific response to China's July intercontinental ballistic missile test, which occurred during a summit marred by allegations of Chinese interference. The test, which China conducted with little notice to some nations, demonstrated its military strength in a region where it seeks to...
summary.zh: 帕劳总统周四呼吁太平洋国家对中国7月份的洲际弹道导弹试验做出“统一”回应，此次试验发生在一个被指控存在北京干预的峰会闭幕之际。中国在进行此次试验前只提前通知了少数几个国家，展示了其在该地区不断扩张影响力的军事实力。尽管遭到一些太平洋领导人的谴责，但太平洋岛国论坛尚未对此试验做出正式回应。

body.en: Palau’s president called on Thursday for a “unified” Pacific response to July’s missile test by China on the final day of a summit clouded by alleged Beijing meddling. Palau President Surangel Whipps. Photo: Palau Gov’t. China gave only a handful of nations short notice before test-firing an intercontinental ballistic missile in July, flexing its military might in a region where it has long sought to expand its reach. It sparked condemnation from multiple Pacific leaders, but the 18-member Pacific Islands Forum being held in Palau, is yet to issue a formal response to the test. Palau, which invited its diplomatic ally Taiwan to attend sideline events as an aid partner, has urged the region to send a strong message. “That’s definitely something that we’ll be discussing today, and a unified Pacific voice is critical in getting Beijing to respect sovereignty, to respect transparency, and to be a responsible partner,” Palau President Surangel Whipps told journalists. “I think that’s the message that we should be sending to Beijing. So it’s important we have a unified position and we’ll work on that.” Whipps said Beijing had “threatened and really disrespected” the region with the test of the rocket, which monitors said appeared to land in a patch of ocean somewhere between Solomon Islands, Nauru and Tuvalu. “They never bothered to tell us that that’s what’s happening,” he said. Beijing said the test launch was “a routine arrangement of China’s annual military training”, and that “relevant countries were informed in advance”. The Pacific forum culminates with a leaders’ retreat on Thursday, during which officials are expecting to hammer out wording for a joint communique. China’s security and economic influence has added resonance this year as the summit is being hosted by Palau. Beijing’s Pacific envoy Qian Bo said there would be “consequences” after Taiwan Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung joined the opening ceremony. A growing number of leaders have skipped this year’s forum and sent lower-ranked ministers in their place. Winston Peters. Photo: Wikicommons via CC2.0. New Zealand Foreign Minister Winston Peters suggested foreign interference behind the scenes may have played a role in the absences. “Well, you’d be defying gravity and logic if you said it wasn’t a big problem,” he said. Kiribati’s pro-Beijing president had already said he would not be attending. Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale unexpectedly flew out of Palau on Sunday to deal with a political crisis at home after a no-confidence motion was lodged against his...
body.zh: 帕劳总统周四呼吁太平洋地区对中国七月份的导弹试验做出“统一”反应，峰会最后一天因北京干预而蒙上阴影。帕劳总统苏兰吉尔·惠普斯。 Photo: Palau Gov’t.中国在7月试射洲际弹道导弹之前只在短时间内通知了少数几个国家，在其长期以来寻求扩大影响力的地区展示了其军事实力。这引发了多位太平洋领导人的谴责，但在帕劳举行的由 18 名成员组成的太平洋岛屿论坛尚未对此次测试做出正式回应。帕劳邀请其外交盟友台湾作为援助伙伴参加场外活动，并敦促该地区发出强烈信息。帕劳总统苏兰吉尔·惠普斯对记者表示：“这肯定是我们今天要讨论的问题，太平洋地区的统一声音对于让北京尊重主权、尊重透明度并成为负责任的伙伴至关重要。” “我认为这就是我们应该向北京传达的信息。因此，重要的是我们有一个统一的立场，我们将为此努力。”惠普斯表示，北京的火箭测试“威胁并且确实不尊重”该地区，监测人员称火箭似乎降落在所罗门群岛、瑙鲁和图瓦卢之间的一片海域。 “他们从来没有费心告诉我们这就是正在发生的事情，”他说。北京表示，此次试射是“中国年度军事训练的例行安排”，并“提前通知了有关国家”。周四的领导人务虚会使太平洋论坛达到高潮，官员们预计在此期间敲定联合公报的措辞。由于今年峰会由帕劳主办，中国的安全和经济影响力增加了共鸣。北京太平洋事务特使钱波表示，台湾外交部长林家龙参加开幕式后将会产生“后果”。越来越多的领导人缺席了今年的论坛，并派出级别较低的部长代替他们。 Winston Peters.照片：维基共享资源，来自 CC2.0。新西兰外交部长温斯顿·彼得斯表示，外国幕后干预可能是造成缺席的原因之一。 “好吧，如果你说这不是一个大问题，那你就是在挑战重力和逻辑，”他说。基里巴斯亲北京总统已经表示他不会出席。所罗门群岛总理马修·威尔周日出人意料地飞离帕劳，应对国内的政治危机，此前有人对他的总理提出了不信任动议。

reflection.en: The launch of an intercontinental ballistic missile by China, and Palau's call for a unified regional response, underscores the persistent global tension surrounding military power. Isaiah's prophecy offers a vision of hope, where nations will 'beat their swords into plowshares,' signifying a future where military might is transformed into tools for peace...
reflection.zh: 中国发射洲际弹道导弹，以及帕劳呼吁太平洋地区做出统一回应，都凸显了围绕军事力量的持续全球紧张局势。以赛亚的预言提供了一个充满希望的愿景，即列国将‘把他们的刀打成犁头’，象征着一个军事力量被转化为和平与生产工具的未来。愿领导人寻求这样的裁军与合作之路。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Three women charged over Kwun Tong mall fight
title.zh: 三女子就觀塘商场打斗案被控

summary.en: Three women appeared in court on Thursday over a brawl in a Kwun Tong shopping mall last month, in which a five-year-old girl was allegedly slapped. The three defendants were charged with fighting in public. One of the women, a 68-year-old, was also charged with common assault.
summary.zh: 三名女子周四就上月在观塘一间购物商场发生的打斗案出庭，事件中一名五岁女童据称被掌掴。三名被告被控在公众场所打斗。其中一名六十八岁的女子另被控普通袭击罪。

body.en: Three women appeared in court on Thursday over a brawl in a Kwun Tong shopping mall last month, in which a five-year-old girl was allegedly slapped. The three defendants were charged with fighting in public. One of the women, a 68-year-old, was also charged with common assault. They appeared at Kwun Tong Magistrates' Courts, where they were not required to enter a plea. The case was adjourned to November 5 for further mention. All three were granted bail of HK$5,000 each. They are banned from entering APM Mall. A second woman, a 34-year-old who is the mother of the five-year-old, was also ordered not to leave Hong Kong. The court heard that the three women are accused of taking part in an unlawful fight in a public area on August 26. The 68-year-old defendant is separately accused of assaulting the girl. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 周四，三名妇女因上个月在观塘一家购物中心发生的斗殴事件出庭，据称一名五岁女孩被打耳光。三名被告被指控公开打架。其中一名 68 岁的妇女还被指控犯有普通袭击罪。他们在观塘裁判法院出庭，但无需答辩。该案押后至11月5日进一步审理。三人均获准保释，每人 5,000 港元。他们被禁止进入 APM 购物中心。第二名女性，一名 34 岁的女子，也是 5 岁孩子的母亲，也被勒令不得离开香港。法庭获悉，三名女子被指控于8月26日在公共场所参与非法斗殴。68岁的被告被另外指控殴打女孩。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The news of a fight in a Kwun Tong mall, where a young child was allegedly harmed, calls to mind the responsibility we have to protect the vulnerable. Scripture urges us to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially children caught in adult conflict. May we always advocate for their safety and well-being.
reflection.zh: 观塘商场发生打斗事件，一名幼童据称在事件中受害，这则新闻提醒我们有责任保护弱者。圣经敦促我们要为那些不能为自己发声的人，特别是卷入成人冲突中的儿童，挺身而出。愿我们永远为他们的安全和福祉发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Operators of over 60% of subdivided flats apply for 3-year grace period to meet rules
title.zh: 香港逾六成劏房业主申请三年宽限期以符合规定

summary.en: In Hong Kong, more than 60% of operators of subdivided flats have applied for a three-year grace period to comply with new housing regulations introduced six months ago. As of Monday, these applications covered over 70,000 units, more than doubling the number of applications received previously.
summary.zh: 香港超过六成的劏房业主已申请为期三年的宽限期，以遵守六个月前推出的新住房规定。截至周一，这些申请涉及超过7万个劏房单位，数量较之前翻倍。

body.en: Operators of over 60 per cent of subdivided flats in Hong Kong have applied for a three-year grace period to give themselves more time to comply with a regulatory regime rolled out six months ago, the housing minister has said. Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho Wing-yin said on Thursday the applications involved more than 70,000 subdivided units from about 20,000 complete flats, as of Monday. This was more than double the 34,000 applications received as of August 10. Monday marked the deadline for...
body.zh: 住房部长表示，香港超过60%的分间公寓的经营者已申请三年宽限期，以便有更多时间遵守六个月前推出的监管制度。房屋局局长何永贤周四表示，截至周一，申请涉及约 20,000 个完整单位中的 70,000 多个分间单位。这是截至 8 月 10 日收到的 34,000 份申请的两倍多。周一是...的截止日期。

reflection.en: The housing minister's announcement about the majority of subdivided flat operators seeking extensions to comply with regulations raises questions about the living conditions and rights of those in these units. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This passage...
reflection.zh: 房屋局局长宣布大部分劏房业主申请延长合规期限，这引发了对劏房住户生活条件和权利的关注。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这段经文提醒我们，要关注弱势群体，确保法规能促进所有人的福祉，特别是那些居住在不稳定住房条件中的人们。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Three arrested on anniversary of 2019 incident involving suspected police violence at Prince Edward station
title.zh: 2019年事件周年纪念，王子园站涉嫌警暴事件，三人被捕

summary.en: Hong Kong police confirmed three arrests near Prince Edward station on Monday evening, the seventh anniversary of officers storming train carriages during citywide protests. The individuals, aged 33 to 79, were arrested for alleged disorderly conduct and have been released on bail.
summary.zh: 香港警方证实，周一晚间在太子站附近进行了三次逮捕，这是警方在全港抗议期间冲进列车车厢七周年纪念日。被捕者年龄在33至79岁之间，涉嫌在公共场所行为失当，已被保释。

body.en: Hong Kong police have confirmed that they made three arrests near Prince Edward station on Monday as people gathered there seven years since officers stormed train carriages amid citywide protests. People gather outside Prince Edward station on August 31, 2026. Photo: The Collective. One woman and two men were arrested around the MTR station on Monday evening for alleged disorderly conduct in a public place, police said in a written response to HKFP. The arrestees, aged 33 to 79, have been released on bail and told to report to police in early October. ‘Support freedom’ Local news outlet The Collective reported on Monday that people had arrived at the scene to lay yellow and white flowers in commemoration of the incident. Among them were activist and dentist Lee Ying-chi, who was fired by her clinic in July after she staged a solo protest on the seventh anniversary of an infamous mob attack targeting protesters and passers-by in Yuen Long on July 21, 2019. As rain fell on Monday evening, one person held up a yellow umbrella printed with Chinese characters that read: “Support freedom, oppose the evil law” – a 2019 protest slogan that appeared on umbrellas distributed by the now-shuttered newspaper Apple Daily . A passerby holds an umbrella printed with a 2019 protest slogan as rains falls around Prince Edward station on August 31, 2026. Photo: The Collective. Police officers stopped and searched several people outside the station, with at least three led into police vehicles, The Collective reported. Sensitive date Monday marked the seventh anniversary of a significant episode during the protests and unrest of 2019. On August 31, 2019, baton-wielding riot police stormed Prince Edward MTR station following hours of protest clashes. Officers were filmed pepper-spraying people in carriages as they drove away reporters and medics. Discrepancies in official records of injuries and the closure of the station fuelled unverified rumours of civilian deaths. The police watchdog largely cleared the force of wrongdoing but faced criticism for lacking independence and investigatory powers in its probe. The incident sparked widespread public outrage and the date remains sensitive for both police and supporters of the protests, which erupted in June 2019 over a since-axed extradition bill . These escalated into sometimes violent displays of dissent against police behaviour, amid calls for democracy and anger over Beijing’s encroachment. Demonstrators demanded an independent probe into police conduct, amnesty for those arrested and a halt to the characterisation of protests as “riots.”
body.zh: 香港警方证实，他们周一在太子车站附近逮捕了三人，七年前，警察在全市范围的抗议活动中冲进了火车车厢，人们聚集在那里。 2026 年 8 月 31 日，人们聚集在爱德华王子站外。照片：The Collective。警方在给《香港新闻报》的书面回应中表示，周一晚间，一名女子和两名男子因涉嫌在公共场所扰乱公共秩序而在港铁站附近被捕。被捕者年龄介乎33岁至79岁，现已获准保释，并被告知于10月初向警方报到。 “支持自由” 当地新闻媒体 The Collective 周一报道称，人们已抵达现场，献上黄色和白色的鲜花以纪念这一事件。其中包括活动人士兼牙医李英吉，她在 2019 年 7 月 21 日元朗针对抗议者和路人的臭名昭著的暴民袭击七周年之际举行了单独抗议，并于 7 月被诊所解雇。周一晚上下雨时，一个人举着一把黄色雨伞，上面写着：“支持自由，反对恶法”——这是 2019 年的抗议口号，出现在由元朗分发的雨伞上。现已关闭的报纸《苹果日报》。 2026 年 8 月 31 日，爱德华太子车站周围下雨，一名路人举着印有 2019 年抗议口号的雨伞。照片：The Collective。据《The Collective》报道，警察在车站外拦截并搜查了几人，其中至少三人被带入警车。周一的敏感日期是 2019 年抗议和骚乱期间发生的重大事件七周年。2019 年 8 月 31 日，在持续数小时的抗议冲突后，挥舞警棍的防暴警察袭击了太子地铁站。警察在赶走记者和医务人员时，拍摄到警察向车厢内的人们喷胡椒喷雾。官方受伤记录和车站关闭的差异助长了未经证实的平民死亡谣言。警方监管机构基本上清除了不法行为，但因调查缺乏独立性和调查权力而面临批评。该事件引发了广泛的公众愤怒，这一日期对于警方和抗议活动的支持者来说仍然敏感，抗议活动于 2019 年 6 月因一项已被废除的引渡法案而爆发。在呼吁民主和对北京侵犯的愤怒中，这些事件有时升级为针对警察行为的暴力表达。示威者要求对警察行为进行独立调查，对被捕者进行大赦，并停止将抗议活动定性为“骚乱”。

reflection.en: Seven years after officers stormed train carriages at Prince Edward station, people gathered to mark the anniversary, leading to three arrests. This anniversary highlights the lingering pain and potential for continued tension. The call to 'overcome evil with good' (Romans 12:21) challenges us to break cycles of retaliation, seeking reconciliation and peace...
reflection.zh: 七年前，警察冲进太子站的列车车厢，七年后，人们聚集在此纪念这一天，导致三人被捕。这个周年纪念日凸显了挥之不去的伤痛和持续紧张的可能性。《罗马书》12章21节呼吁我们“以善胜恶”，这挑战我们打破报复的循环，即使过去的伤痛依然存在，也要寻求和解与和平。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Hong Kong considers DNA testing amid concerns over ‘fighting dog’ classification
title.zh: 香港考虑 DNA 检测，因担忧“斗犬”分类

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities are considering genetic testing as a supplementary tool for identifying breeds, an official has said after enforcement action against suspected fighting dogs sparked public concern. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) also said on Thursday that owners could keep existing...
summary.zh: 香港当局正在考虑使用基因检测作为识别犬种的辅助工具，一位官员在针对疑似斗犬的执法行动引发公众担忧后表示。渔农自然护理署（AFCD）周四还表示，只要符合法定要求，主人可以继续饲养现有的斗犬，并敦促主人不要遗弃宠物。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities are considering genetic testing as a supplementary tool for identifying breeds, an official has said after enforcement action against suspected fighting dogs sparked public concern. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) also said on Thursday that owners could keep existing fighting dogs, provided they complied with statutory requirements, and urged owners not to abandon their pets. Dr Michelle Yeung Lee, the department’s principal veterinary officer,...
body.zh: 在针对涉嫌斗犬的执法行动引发公众担忧后，一名官员表示，香港当局正在考虑将基因检测作为识别品种的补充工具。渔农自然护理署（渔护署）周四还表示，只要符合法定要求，主人可以保留现有的斗犬，并敦促主人不要遗弃宠物。该署首席兽医主任李美雪医生...

reflection.en: The news that Hong Kong is exploring DNA testing for dog breeds highlights a concern for clear identification and proper care. This echoes the call in Proverbs to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves." Even in matters of animal welfare, there is a need to ensure fairness and prevent undue suffering, reflecting a broader principle of advocacy...
reflection.zh: 香港正在探索犬种 DNA 检测的消息，凸显了对清晰识别和妥善照顾的关注。这呼应了《箴言》中“为不能自辩的开口”的呼吁。即使在动物福利方面，也需要确保公平并防止不必要的痛苦，这反映了为弱势群体发声的更广泛原则。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Retired Cardinal Joseph Zen, 4 others lose appeal over failure to register protest fund
title.zh: 退休枢机主教陈日君等4人就未能注册抗议基金上诉失败

summary.en: Retired Catholic leader Joseph Zen Ze-kiun and four other activists have lost an appeal against their convictions for failing to register their legal defense fund for those involved in the 2019 anti-government protests in Hong Kong. The Court of Appeal upheld a magistrate’s findings that the fund, the now-defunct 612...
summary.zh: 香港退休天主教领袖陈日君枢机及另外四名活动人士，在未能为2019年反政府抗议活动相关人士的法律辩护基金进行注册而被定罪，他们就此提起的上诉已于周四被上诉法院驳回。上诉法院维持了裁判官的裁决，认为该已停运的“612人道支援基金”属于《社团条例》下的社团定义，其成员有义务向警方注册该组织。

body.en: Retired Catholic leader Joseph Zen Ze-kiun and four other activists have lost an appeal against their convictions for failing to register their legal defence fund for those involved in the 2019 anti-government protests in Hong Kong. The Court of Appeal on Thursday upheld a magistrate’s findings that the now-defunct 612 Humanitarian Relief Fund fell within the definition of a society under the Societies Ordinance and its members were required to register the group with police or ask for an...
body.zh: 退休天主教领袖陈日君和其他四名活动人士因未能为参与 2019 年香港反政府抗议活动的人士登记法律辩护基金，在上诉中败诉。上诉法院周四维持了裁判官的裁决，即现已解散的 612 人道主义救济基金符合《社团条例》对社团的定义，其成员必须向警方登记该团体或要求...

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, retired Cardinal Joseph Zen and four others have lost their appeal regarding the failure to register a fund for protesters. This situation brings to the fore the tension between obeying state laws and following one's conscience, particularly when those laws are perceived to impede justice or support. The principle of prioritizing divine...
reflection.zh: 在香港，退休的陈日君枢机及另外四人就未能注册一个为抗议者设立的基金的上诉已告失败。这一情况凸显了在遵守国家法律与遵循良知之间存在的张力，尤其当法律被认为阻碍了公正或支持时。将神圣的命令置于人类命令之上的原则，为应对此类艰难抉择提供了指导。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: 3 women charged with fighting in Hong Kong mall granted bail, banned from venue
title.zh: 香港商场斗殴三女子获准保释，禁止进入该场所

summary.en: Three women were granted bail by a Hong Kong court after being charged with fighting in the children's play area of a shopping center. They have also been banned from returning to the venue. The altercation, which occurred on August 26 at the APM shopping center, was captured on video and posted on social media.
summary.zh: 香港法院已批准三名女子保释，她们被控在一家购物中心的儿童游乐区打架，并被禁止返回该场所。这起发生在8月26日观塘apm商场中庭的争执被视频记录并发布到社交媒体上。

body.en: A Hong Kong court has granted three women bail after they were charged with fighting in the children’s play area of a shopping centre and barred them from returning to the venue. Leung Lai-ha, 68, her 34-year-old daughter Ng Ka-wun and Xu Yang, 34, made their first appearance at Kwun Tong Court on Thursday to face charges after their altercation on August 26 at the atrium of APM shopping centre in Kwun Tong. Their confrontation was captured in a video posted on social media, and the three...
body.zh: 香港一家法院已批准三名妇女保释，她们被指控在购物中心儿童游乐区打架，并禁止她们返回该场所。 68岁的梁丽霞、34岁的女儿吴家媛和34岁的徐阳于8月26日在观塘APM购物中心中庭发生口角后，周四首次到观塘法院出庭接受指控。他们的对峙被记录在社交媒体上发布的视频中，三人......

reflection.en: A public dispute, captured and amplified by social media, can quickly escalate beyond the initial incident. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that while the first speaker in a dispute might seem convincing, the truth often emerges only after hearing from all parties involved. This incident highlights how easily conflicts can be amplified and judged before all sides...
reflection.zh: 一场被社交媒体捕捉并放大的公开争执，很容易就超出最初事件的范畴。箴言18:17提醒我们，虽然争论中的第一方听起来可能令人信服，但真相往往要等到听取了所有相关方的陈述后才能显现。这起事件凸显了在所有方面都被理解之前，冲突很容易被放大和评判。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: HK dog breed checks shouldn't rely on DNA: SPCA
title.zh: 防止虐待動物協會：香港對犬隻品種的檢查不應依賴 DNA

summary.en: The Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (SPCA) in Hong Kong has stated that the government's restricted-breed law, which allows for dog confiscation based on visual traits, should not rely solely on appearance. They advocate for more accurate methods, such as DNA testing, to avoid misclassifications and...
summary.zh: 香港愛護動物協會（SPCA）表示，政府的限制品種法例允許基於外觀特徵來充公犬隻，這種做法不應僅僅依賴視覺判斷。他們主張採用更準確的方法，例如 DNA 檢測，以避免錯誤分類，進而可能對飼主及其寵物造成傷害。

body.en: The Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (SPCA) said Hong Kong's restricted-breed law allows for dog confiscation based on visual traits, though owners are able to appeal classifications to a review panel. Speaking on RTHK's Backchat programme on Thursday, Fiona Woodhouse, deputy director (welfare) at the SPCA, said the government's classification procedure relies on observable characteristics – rather than DNA testing – to identify restricted breeds. This comes after the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) on Wednesday dismissed a claim that its officers would label a canine as a fighting dog based merely on a quick observation. Addressing the methodology, Woodhouse acknowledged the limitations of genetic testing and pointed to the safeguards built into the current system. "DNA is a little bit more problematic. Characteristics have been used globally in some jurisdictions. And obviously, there are still checks and balances there in that you can appeal against a classification by the government officer, and that will then go to a board that then assesses in a framework," she said. On enforcement, Woodhouse confirmed that if officers spot characteristics raising concerns about a dog's breed, they do have the power to confiscate the dog and take it for an assessment. "They also will allow the dog owner to take the dog to the animal management centre for assessment, but the dog may need to be detained for a short period of time while that assessment is being taken place, but there's some areas that still need to be clarified in terms of timeline by AFCD," she said. Woodhouse also raised concerns about illegal imports, warning that smuggling creates a direct channel for restricted breeds to enter Hong Kong. "You can go into mainland and you can see people advertising quite openly in pet shops and also on social media channels that they can ship dogs to Hong Kong, but they don't mention anything about quarantine," she said. "There is always the opportunity for people to smuggle such animals in, and then that might cause a problem, and obviously, smuggling other breeds in and also bringing disease and rabies into Hong Kong is a problem." On public education, Woodhouse said that while isolated incidents tend to attract media attention, the majority of dogs are well behaved and responsibly managed by their owners. She said the goal is to reassure the public about the existing framework and prevent an overreaction to recent unfortunate events. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 防止虐待动物协会（SPCA）表示，香港的限制品种法允许根据视觉特征没收狗，不过狗主人可以向审查小组提出分类上诉。 SPCA 副主任（福利）菲奥娜·伍德豪斯 (Fiona Woodhouse) 周四在香港电台 Backchat 节目中表示，政府的分类程序依靠可观察的特征（而不是 DNA 测试）来识别限制品种。此前，渔农自然护理署（AFCD）周三驳回了有关官员仅根据快速观察就将犬科动物标记为斗犬的说法。在谈到方法时，伍德豪斯承认基因检测的局限性，并指出了当前系统中内置的保障措施。 “DNA 的问题有点大。特征已在全球某些司法管辖区使用。显然，那里仍然存在制衡，因为你可以对政府官员的分类提出上诉，然后将提交给委员会，然后在框架中进行评估，”她说。在执法方面，伍德豪斯证实，如果官员发现狗的品种引发担忧，他们确实有权没收狗并对其进行评估。她说：“他们也会允许狗主人带狗到动物管理中心进行评估，但在评估期间，狗可能需要被拘留一小段时间，但有些方面仍需要渔护署在时间表上澄清。”伍德豪斯还对非法进口表示担忧，警告称走私为限制品种进入香港创造了直接渠道。她说：“你去大陆，你可以看到人们在宠物店和社交媒体渠道上公开打广告，说他们可以将狗运到香港，但他们没有提到任何有关检疫的事情。” “人们总是有机会走私此类动物，然后这可能会引起问题，显然，走私其他品种并将疾病和狂犬病带入香港也是一个问题。”在公共教育方面，伍德豪斯表示，虽然孤立的事件往往会引起媒体的关注，但大多数狗都表现良好，并受到主人负责任的管理。她说，目标是让公众对现有框架放心，并防止对最近的不幸事件反应过度。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The SPCA is acting as a voice for animals, advocating for fair treatment and accurate identification of restricted dog breeds. Their concern that visual traits alone can lead to confiscation underscores the need to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring justice and compassion prevail even in regulatory matters.
reflection.zh: 香港愛護動物協會正在為動物發聲，倡導公平對待和準確識別受限制的犬種。他們擔心僅憑外觀特徵就可能導致犬隻被充公，這凸顯了為那些無法為自己辯護的生命挺身而出的必要性，確保即使在監管事務中，公正與憐憫也能佔上風。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: T1 to remain in force on Thurs
title.zh: 一号戒备信号周四维持

summary.en: The Hong Kong Observatory announced that Standby Signal No. 1 will remain in effect on Thursday. They will reassess the need for a higher storm signal on Friday, even as Tropical Storm Saudel weakens. The storm is currently located about 360 kilometers northeast of Hong Kong and is moving inland over eastern...
summary.zh: 天文台表示，星期四将继续悬挂一号戒备信号。虽然热带风暴“沙德尔”正在减弱，但天文台将于星期五评估是否需要发出更高风球。沙德尔目前估计位于香港东北约360公里处，并正横过广东省东部内陆，逐渐减弱。然而，随着它于星期五接近珠江口，其减弱程度仍存在不确定性。由于沙德尔及其他因素的影响，离岸及高地风势间中强劲。

body.en: The Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 would remain in force on Thursday and it would assess the need for a higher storm signal on Friday even though Tropical Storm Saudel is weakening. Acting senior scientific officer Shum Chi-tai said Saudel was estimated to be about 360 kilometres northeast of Hong Kong at noon on Thursday. “Saudel is moving across the inland areas of eastern Guangdong and weakening gradually,” he said. “Saudel is expected to edge closer to the vicinity of the Pearl Estuary tomorrow (Friday), but there are uncertainties in its degree of weakening.” He added that local winds were occasionally strong offshore and on high ground due to the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 天文台表示，一号待命信号将于周四继续生效，并将评估周五是否需要发出更高的风暴信号，尽管热带风暴沙德尔正在减弱。署理高级科学官员岑志泰表示，估计沙德尔于周四中午出现在香港东北约 360 公里处。 “萨德尔正在穿越粤东内陆地区，并逐渐减弱，”他说。 “预计明天（周五）‘萨德尔’将逼近珍珠口附近，但其减弱程度存在不确定性。”他补充说，由于萨德尔和东北季风的共同影响，近海和高地的当地风偶尔会强劲。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: As Tropical Storm Saudel approaches, bringing winds and uncertainty, we are reminded that even as storms weaken, they can still cause disruption. In times of potential danger and unpredictable weather, Psalm 46:1 offers a profound truth: God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. We can face the anxieties of the unknown with a...
reflection.zh: 随着热带风暴“沙德尔”的逼近，带来风雨和不确定性，我们被提醒，即使风暴减弱，仍可能造成混乱。在潜在危险和不可预测的天气中，诗篇46:1 提供了一个深刻的真理：上帝是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。我们可以带着坚定的盼望面对未知的焦虑，知道自己被稳妥地保守。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: No sign of WT1 jab in vaccines crackdown
title.zh: WT1疫苗在疫苗打击中无踪影

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities have not found any Wilms' tumour 1 (WT1) vaccines during raids on 14 premises and the arrest of three people, seizing over 890 vaccine vials. The operation was prompted by concerns that some health centers were falsely advertising the WT1 vaccine for cancer prevention. While no WT1 vaccines were...
summary.zh: 香港当局在突击搜查14个场所并逮捕三人、缴获超过890瓶疫苗后，并未发现任何一种名为WT1的肿瘤疫苗。此次行动源于对一些健康中心声称提供WT1疫苗以预防某些癌症的担忧。尽管未找到WT1疫苗，但当局缴获了约20种疑似未经注册的注射剂，其中大部分是维生素和氨基酸保健注射剂。

body.en: Assistant Director of Health Frank Chan on Thursday said authorities had not found any Wilms' tumour 1 (WT1) vaccines after police and the Department of Health raided 14 premises and arrested three people while seizing more than 890 vaccine vials. The operation came amid concerns that some health centres were claiming to offer the WT1 vaccine as a way to prevent certain types of cancers. Speaking on an RTHK radio programme, Chan said authorities had not found any WT1 jabs during the raids, nor discovered anyone who had received it. However, among the items seized, he said, were some 20 types of suspected unregistered jabs, with most of them being vitamins and amino acid health injections. Chan warned that people could put their lives at risks if they get the unregistered WT1 vaccine. “Because this is an injectable. We are very worried that during manufacturing or the administration of the injection, there may be a bacterial infection, posing risks to the recipient," he said. "Mild bacterial infection could lead to fever and inflammation, but severe ones could result in organ damage or even death.” Chan said investigations showed that a local company had supplied WT1 reagents to some medical centres. He went on to say that the reagents were labelled for research purpose only, and not for human use. It is believed that the local firm obtained the reagents from overseas, he added. Chan urged the public not to trust relevant advertisements easily, while health authorities have required local health providers to take down the advertisements for the jab. As relevant promotions often appeared on social media platforms on the mainland, Chan said the department had also notified mainland authorities to help remove them. All medical advertisements are strictly regulated under the laws in Hong Kong, Chan added, and authorities would take strict enforcement actions if they discovered any false advertising. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 卫生部助理总监 Frank Chan 周四表示，警方和卫生部突击搜查了 14 个场所并逮捕了三人，并没收了 890 多瓶疫苗后，当局尚未发现任何威姆斯氏瘤 1 (WT1) 疫苗。此次行动的背景是，一些卫生中心声称提供 WT1 疫苗作为预防某些类型癌症的一种方法。陈在香港电台广播节目中表示，当局在突击搜查期间没有发现任何 WT1 疫苗，也没有发现任何人接受过该疫苗。不过，他说，在查获的物品中，有约20种疑似未经注册的疫苗，其中大部分是维生素和氨基酸保健注射剂。 Chan 警告说，如果人们接种未经注册的 WT1 疫苗，可能会面临生命危险。 “因为这是一种注射剂。我们非常担心在注射剂的制造或注射过程中，可能会出现细菌感染，给接受者带来风险，”他说。 “轻微的细菌感染可能会导致发烧和炎症，但严重的细菌感染可能会导致器官损伤甚至死亡。”陈说，调查显示，一家本地公司曾向一些医疗中心提供WT1试剂。他接着说，这些试剂的标签仅供研究用途，不适合人类使用。他补充说，据信当地公司从海外获得了这些试剂。陈敦促公众不要轻易相信相关广告，而卫生当局已要求当地医疗服务提供者撤下疫苗接种广告。由于相关宣传经常出现在内地社交媒体平台上，陈表示，该部门也已通知内地当局帮助删除这些宣传。陈补充说，所有医疗广告都受到香港法律的严格监管，如果当局发现任何虚假广告，将采取严厉执法行动。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, authorities are cracking down on suspected unregistered vaccines, arresting individuals and seizing vials. This action reflects a commitment to upholding standards and protecting the public from potentially harmful or fraudulent health products. It calls to mind the prophet Micah's words, urging a pursuit of justice and ethical practice in all...
reflection.zh: 在香港，当局正在打击涉嫌未经注册的疫苗，逮捕相关人员并查获疫苗。此举体现了维护标准和保护公众免受潜在有害或欺诈性健康产品侵害的承诺。这让人想起先知弥迦的话，敦促在所有交易中追求公义和道德实践。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: HKFP joins the SPUR Coalition to defend original reporting against unpaid use by AI
title.zh: HKFP加入SPUR联盟，捍卫原创报道免遭无偿使用AI

summary.en: Hong Kong Free Press (HKFP) has joined the SPUR Coalition, an initiative by major news organizations like the BBC and The Guardian, to advocate for fair compensation and a structured relationship with AI companies that utilize news content. HKFP is the first Hong Kong-based outlet to join, emphasizing its commitment...
summary.zh: 香港自由新闻（HKFP）已加入SPUR联盟，该联盟由BBC和卫报等主要新闻机构发起，旨在争取与使用新闻内容的AI公司建立公平的报酬和结构化关系。HKFP是香港首家加入该联盟的媒体，强调其致力于在人工智能时代捍卫和实现本地新闻业的盈利。

body.en: Hong Kong Free Press has become an associate member of the SPUR Coalition as we seek a fair, rules-based relationship with the AI firms who have been benefitting from our newsroom’s journalism without payment. The SPUR Coalition. Initiated this February by organisations including the BBC, Financial Times, Sky News and The Guardian, the coalition aims to shape the rules, standards and infrastructure that will enable a constructive relationship between news media and tech companies. HKFP is the first to sign up in Hong Kong. Defending original journalism The move is part of our newsroom’s effort to lead the charge in defending, protecting and monetising local journalism in the era of generative AI. HKFP’s output was found to be the most cited Hong Kong news dataset in Google’s AI training model back in 2023. And, while our reporting is – on principle – free to air, it is not free to use. We’ve therefore sought to regain control over those mining our archive of 30,000-odd news stories. An archive that is the result of 11 years’ work, that has launched the careers of dozens of journalists, and that has been powered largely by reader donations exceeding HK$35 million. OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT. Photo: Levart_Photographer/Unsplash. As New York Times Publisher A.G. Sulzberger said of the tech firms in June: “Their hijacking of the public square is made possible by the original sin that animates their AI products — a brazen theft of intellectual property that has occurred at an unprecedented scale. Tech giants strip-mine news websites without permission or compensation. They repackage these stolen goods as their own, siphoning off the audiences and revenue that otherwise would go to the news organisations that created this work. And this happens not just once during the training process, but countless times every single day.” “Our profession has been too quiet, too passive and too fragmented in the face of abuses by the companies leading the A.I. revolution… We cannot watch as AI companies attempt to permanently dismantle the rights that give us control over the work we create. We cannot sit by as this work is used to build replacement products that undermine our ability to earn the audience and revenue necessary to continue reporting the news.” Setting ground rules Big tech is scooping up our audience, as well as journalism. With the advent of synthesised “AI summaries,” and internet users turning to AI chatbots, we are seeing “referrals” (clicks back to our news website) being decimated across search engines and social media platforms. Google Gemini. Photo: HKFP screenshot. But, unlike the New York Times and others, we are not big enough to launch legal action or strike deals with the likes of OpenAI or...
body.zh: 香港自由新闻已成为 SPUR 联盟的准成员，因为我们寻求与人工智能公司建立公平、基于规则的关系，这些公司一直从我们新闻编辑室的新闻报道中免费受益。 SPUR 联盟。该联盟由 BBC、金融时报、天空新闻和卫报等组织于今年二月发起，旨在制定规则、标准和基础设施，以促进新闻媒体和科技公司之间建立建设性关系。 HKFP是第一个在香港注册的。捍卫原创新闻业这一举措是我们新闻编辑室在生成人工智能时代引领捍卫、保护当地新闻业并使其货币化的努力的一部分。 HKFP 的输出被发现是 2023 年 Google 人工智能训练模型中被引用最多的香港新闻数据集。而且，虽然我们的报道原则上是免费播出的，但它并不是免费使用的。因此，我们试图重新控制那些挖掘我们 30,000 多条新闻报道档案的人。该档案是 11 年工作的成果，开启了数十名记者的职业生涯，其动力主要来自超过 3,500 万港元的读者捐款。 OpenAI，ChatGPT 的创建者。照片：Levart_Photographer/Unsplash。正如《纽约时报》出版商 A.G. 苏兹贝格 (A.G. Sulzberger) 在 6 月份谈到科技公司时所言：“他们对公共广场的劫持是由于他们的人工智能产品的原罪——一种以前所未有的规模发生的公然盗窃知识产权的行为。科技巨头在未经许可或补偿的情况下剥夺新闻网站的所有权。他们将这些赃物重新包装为自己的，吸走观众和收入，否则这些内容将流向创作这项作品的新闻机构。而且这种情况不止一次发生在训练过程中，但每天都有无数次。” “面对引领人工智能革命的公司的滥用行为，我们的职业太安静、太被动、太支离破碎……我们不能眼睁睁地看着人工智能公司试图永久剥夺我们对自己创作的作品的控制权。我们不能袖手旁观，因为这些作品被用来构建替代产品，从而削弱我们赢得观众和继续报道新闻所需收入的能力。”设定基本规则大型科技正在吸引我们的受众以及新闻业。随着综合“人工智能摘要”的出现，以及互联网用户转向人工智能聊天机器人，我们看到搜索引擎和社交媒体平台上的“推荐”（点击返回我们的新闻网站）正在大幅减少。谷歌双子座。照片：HKFP 截图。但是，与《纽约时报》和其他媒体不同的是，我们的规模还不够大，无法发起法律行动或与 OpenAI 或谷歌等公司达成交易……

reflection.en: In an era where information is rapidly disseminated and repurposed, Hong Kong Free Press's proactive stance with the SPUR Coalition highlights the vital role of original reporting. Their pursuit of fair terms for their journalism underscores the principle that truth, diligently uncovered, has inherent value and deserves rightful recognition and...
reflection.zh: 在一个信息迅速传播和被重新利用的时代，香港自由新闻加入SPUR联盟的积极姿态，凸显了原创报道的关键作用。他们为新闻业争取公平条款的努力，印证了勤奋挖掘出的真相具有内在价值，值得应有的认可和报酬，这呼应了真相终将使人自由的理念。

verse.textEn: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
verse.textZh: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 希恩（Shein）让伦敦股市躲过一劫 | 尼尔斯·普拉特利

summary.en: China's fashion giant Shein will list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation, accompanied by significant questions surrounding its business practices. The article speculates on a parallel reality where Shein might have pursued a listing on the London Stock Exchange, a move that was actively courted by politicians...
summary.zh: 中国的时尚巨头希恩（Shein）将以缩水的估值在香港上市，其商业模式引发了重大疑问。文章设想了另一种可能，即希恩本可能在伦敦证券交易所上市，而英国政界曾积极争取，希望借此提振当地的上市市场并展现对国际资本的开放态度。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大疑问在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。 2024 年和去年，随着两个主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news about Shein's Hong Kong listing, with its "shrunken price tag" and "big questions over its business model," highlights the ongoing tension between commerce and ethics. Micah 6:8 calls us to "act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." This ancient wisdom challenges us to consider the ethical foundations of global business,...
reflection.zh: 关于希恩（Shein）在香港上市的新闻，伴随着其“缩水的估值”和“商业模式的重大疑问”，凸显了商业与道德之间持续存在的张力。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行”。这古老的智慧促使我们反思全球商业的道德基础，并敦促我们在所有交易中走上正直和公平的道路。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论：天安门守夜案宣判——香港亦被噤声，他人应发声

summary.en: Two activists who organized commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime. For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the...
summary.zh: 两名组织纪念中国1989年镇压民主抗议活动的活动家面临牢狱之灾。铭记并非罪行。几十年来，当中国大陆无法悼念时，香港却在哀悼。香港每年举办的大规模天安门守夜活动，让人们记住了1989年北京的改革抗议以及镇压它们的屠杀。连同澳门，香港是中国唯一能够公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。然而，2019年香港抗议活动遭到镇压，粉碎...

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年民主抗议活动血腥镇压的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Hong Kong activists for organizing Tiananmen Square commemorations underscores a deep tension between state authority and the human impulse to remember and bear witness. When laws compel silence on matters of conscience and historical truth, the question arises: to whom do we owe our ultimate obedience? The early Christians faced similar...
reflection.zh: 香港活动家因组织天安门纪念活动而被定罪，这凸显了国家权力与人类纪念和作证的冲动之间的深刻矛盾。当法律迫使人们在良心和历史真相问题上保持沉默时，一个问题随之而来：我们最终应服从谁？早期基督徒也面临过类似的压力，他们说：“我们必须服从雅伟，而不是人！”这一原则促使我们思考，何时公民义务与更高的道德命令相冲突。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Rare trio of Pacific hurricanes fueled by historic El Niño
title.zh: 罕见的三场太平洋飓风由历史性厄尔尼诺现象助长

summary.en: A rare trio of hurricanes were churning through the Pacific Ocean on Thursday, which scientists attributed to waters warmed by a historically strong El Niño phenomenon. Tropical Storm Marie strengthened into a hurricane late Wednesday off the coast of Baja California, lining up behind Hurricanes Karina and Lowell—both...
summary.zh: 周四，罕见的三场飓风正在太平洋上空肆虐，科学家们将此归因于历史上强烈的厄尔尼诺现象导致海水变暖。热带风暴玛丽周三晚间在下加利福尼亚州海岸附近加强为飓风，排在卡琳娜和洛厄尔飓风之后——这两场飓风均为4级——它们正向西横跨太平洋。密歇根大学的气候科学家朱莉娅·科尔告诉法新社，看到三场飓风“绝对罕见”。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A rare trio of hurricanes were churning through the Pacific Ocean on Thursday, which scientists attributed to waters warmed by a historically strong El Niño phenomenon.

Tropical Storm Marie strengthened into a hurricane late Wednesday off the coast of Baja California, lining up behind Hurricanes Karina and Lowell—both rated Category 4—which were making their way westward across the Pacific.

Three hurricanes are "definitely rare to see," Julia Cole, a climate scientist at the University of Michigan, told AFP.

"El Niño warming sets the stage for these storms, which are fueled in large part by warm waters—when the tropical Pacific is warmer than normal we see an increase in strong storms," Cole said.

Lowell was about 440 miles (710 kilometers) south of Hilo, Hawaii, and "is expected to remain a major hurricane for the next several days" as it moves west, according to the National Hurricane Center (NHC).

"Swells from Lowell are likely to cause life-threatening surf and rip current conditions in portions of the Hawaiian Islands during the next several days," the NHC said, adding that its long-range track and intensity forecasts were "more uncertain than usual."

Hawaii is still recovering from the impacts of Hurricane Lala, which brushed past the southern part of the Big Island last month, bringing destructive winds and severe flash floods.

The NHC said late Wednesday that Karina weakened slightly as it moved northwest but is likely to remain a hurricane for the next couple of days.

Lowell and Karina are followed to the east by Marie, which was 375 miles (600 kilometers) southwest of the southern tip of Baja California and expected to strengthen through Friday, according to the NHC.

Warm waters provide fuel for storms, and El Niño's effect on the atmosphere leaves little vertical wind shear over the Pacific, creating favorable conditions for hurricanes to intensify.

"The climate system has significantly warmed over the last 20 years or so," said Benjamin Kirtman, an atmospheric scientist at the University of Miami.

The sea surface temperature anomaly—how much warmer the ocean is compared with average—is already near a record high, Kirtman added.

A similar trend took place in 2015, another intense El Niño year, when Hurricane Kilo, Ignacio, Jimena and Tropical Depression 14E crossed the Pacific at once.

This year's El Niño has a 69% chance of becoming the strongest on record, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, and is already unleashing extreme weather across the globe even though it is not expected to peak until...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 周四，罕见的三场飓风席卷太平洋，科学家将其归因于历史上强烈的厄尔尼诺现象导致海水变暖。 周三晚间，热带风暴玛丽在下加利福尼亚州海岸增强为飓风，紧随飓风卡琳娜和洛厄尔（均为四级飓风）向西横渡太平洋。 密歇根大学气候科学家朱莉娅·科尔告诉法新社，三场飓风“绝对罕见”。 科尔说：“厄尔尼诺现象的变暖为这些风暴奠定了基础，而这些风暴在很大程度上是由温暖的海水推动的——当热带太平洋比正常情况更温暖时，我们就会看到强风暴的增加。” 洛厄尔位于夏威夷希洛以南约 440 英里（710 公里）处，据国家飓风中心 (NHC) 称，随着它向西移动，“预计在接下来的几天内仍将是一场重大飓风”。 NHC 表示：“未来几天，来自洛厄尔的海浪可能会在夏威夷群岛部分地区造成危及生命的海浪和撕裂电流。”并补充说，其长期轨迹和强度预测“比平常更加不确定”。 夏威夷仍在从飓风“拉拉”的影响中恢复，拉拉上个月掠过大岛南部，带来了破坏性的大风和严重的山洪爆发。 美国国家飓风中心周三晚间表示，卡琳娜向西北移动时强度略有减弱，但在未来几天内可能仍将是飓风。 据 NHC 称，紧随洛厄尔和卡琳娜向东的是玛丽，位于下加利福尼亚州南端西南 375 英里（600 公里）处，预计到周五风力增强。 温暖的海水为风暴提供了燃料，而厄尔尼诺现象对大气的影响使得太平洋上空几乎没有垂直风切变，为飓风加剧创造了有利条件。 迈阿密大学大气科学家本杰明·科特曼说：“在过去 20 年左右的时间里，气候系统显着变暖。” 科特曼补充说，海面温度异常——海洋与平均温度相比温暖了多少——已经接近历史最高水平。 类似的趋势也出现在 2015 年，也就是厄尔尼诺现象又一个严重的年份，当时飓风基洛、伊格纳西奥、希梅纳和热带低气压 14E 同时横渡太平洋。 根据美国国家海洋和大气管理局的数据，今年的厄尔尼诺现象有 69% 的可能性成为有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象，并且已经在全球范围内引发了极端天气，尽管预计要到...

reflection.en: The vastness and power of the ocean, capable of generating such rare and intense storms, speak to the grandeur of creation. Even in phenomena that can bring destruction, we see the intricate systems Yahweh established, reminding us of His awesome power and wisdom displayed throughout the cosmos. As scientists observe and explain these events, we are invited...
reflection.zh: 海洋的浩瀚与力量，能够产生如此罕见而强烈的风暴，彰显了造物的宏伟。即使在可能带来毁灭的现象中，我们也看到了雅伟所设立的精密系统，提醒我们祂在整个宇宙中展现的威严大能与智慧。 当科学家们观察和解释这些事件时，我们被邀请惊叹于我们世界的复杂性，并认识到天地万物都在述说造物主的荣耀。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: In Chile, injured penguins sport copper vests to help them heal
title.zh: 在智利，受伤的企鹅穿上铜背心以助其康复

summary.en: Researchers in Chile have developed innovative red vests infused with copper and zinc for injured Humboldt penguins, drawing inspiration from similar treatments used on pets, in hopes of accelerating the birds' healing process.
summary.zh: 智利的科学家们为受伤的洪堡企鹅设计了一种新奇的红色背心，背心中融入了铜和锌，这种设计借鉴了曾用于宠物身上的治疗方法，希望能加速企鹅的康复过程。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers in Chile have designed an unlikely new garment for injured penguins—snug red vests threaded with copper and zinc that they hope will help the aquatic birds heal faster.

Veterinarians have found success in the past using such suits to treat injured dogs and cats. Now they're trying out the technology on Humboldt penguins in Chile, home to the largest concentration of the vulnerable species.

"For years, vests with microfibers containing elements like copper and zinc have been tested on pets, particularly dogs and cats, and have greatly helped in the recovery of skin wounds," said Ignacio Idalsoaga, director of the Buin Zoo, a wildlife park on the outskirts of Chile's capital, Santiago, where researchers took measurements of penguins to develop the first bodysuits.

"We began to wonder—why can't this be used on penguins?" he told The Associated Press from the zoo on Wednesday.

The experiment comes as Chile's Humboldt penguin population declines sharply. Chilean and international researchers surveying the country's major breeding colonies in 2024 and 2025 found a 63% drop in active nests compared to the same sites three years earlier. The birds face mounting threats, including entanglement in fishing nets, plastic pollution, disease outbreaks and competition with fisheries for food.

Now Humboldt penguins also find themselves in the cross hairs of one of the world's most disruptive weather patterns , El Niño, which brings unusually warm waters to parts of the Pacific Ocean, making the cold-water fish that they rely on harder to find. Hunger forces penguin parents to travel farther afield for food and leave their nests behind.

"Especially now, with all the problems caused by El Niño, we're likely to see many abandoned chicks in the coming weeks, with injuries they suffer in the environment," Idalsoaga said.

Wildlife clinics across Chile receive distressed penguins stranded along Chile's coast, some cut by fishing nets or boat propellers, others weakened by a lack of food, said Tomás Pino, a veterinarian who runs Conservación Humboldt, a nonprofit that rehabilitates injured marine animals in the country's north.

Treating those injuries can be tricky. Penguins often twist their long necks to peck at gashes and pull out their own stitches, Pino said. The vests prevent them from doing that while putting copper—of which Chile is the world's top producer—to work as a salve. Copper and zinc woven into the fabric inhibit the growth of bacteria and fungi. Zinc also stimulates the formation of new blood vessels, helping damaged tissue heal faster.
