body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 智利的研究人员为受伤的企鹅设计了一种不太可能的新服装——用铜和锌制成的舒适的红色背心，他们希望这能帮助这些水生鸟类更快地康复。 兽医过去已经成功地使用这种套装来治疗受伤的狗和猫。现在，他们正在智利的洪堡企鹅身上尝试这项技术，这里是脆弱物种最集中的地方。 位于智利首都圣地亚哥郊区的布因动物园 (Buin Zoo) 园长伊格纳西奥·伊达萨加 (Ignacio Idalsoaga) 表示：“多年来，含有铜和锌等元素的超细纤维背心已经在宠物身上进行了测试，尤其是狗和猫，对皮肤伤口的恢复有很大帮助。” “我们开始想知道——为什么这不能用在企鹅身上？”周三，他在动物园告诉美联社。 这项实验正值智利洪堡企鹅数量急剧下降之际。智利和国际研究人员在 2024 年和 2025 年对该国主要繁殖地进行了调查，发现与三年前相同地点相比，活跃巢穴数量减少了 63%。这些鸟类面临着越来越大的威胁，包括被渔网缠住、塑料污染、疾病爆发以及与渔业的食物竞争。 现在，洪堡企鹅也发现自己陷入了世界上最具破坏性的天气模式之一——厄尔尼诺现象的十字路口，厄尔尼诺现象给太平洋部分地区带来了异常温暖的海水，使得它们赖以生存的冷水鱼更难找到。饥饿迫使企鹅父母离开巢穴，前往更远的地方寻找食物。 “特别是现在，由于厄尔尼诺现象造成的所有问题，我们可能会在未来几周内看到许多被遗弃的小鸡，它们在环境中受到伤害，”伊达索加说。 智利各地的野生动物诊所接收滞留在智利海岸的受困企鹅，其中一些被渔网或船螺旋桨割伤，另一些则因缺乏食物而虚弱，经营着洪堡保护组织的兽医托马斯·皮诺说，该组织是一家致力于康复该国北部受伤海洋动物的非营利组织。 治疗这些伤害可能很棘手。皮诺说，企鹅经常扭转它们的长脖子来啄伤口并拔掉自己的缝线。这些背心阻止他们这样做，同时将铜（智利是世界上最大的铜生产国）用作药膏。织入织物中的铜和锌可抑制细菌和真菌的生长。锌还能刺激新血管的形成，帮助受损组织更快愈合。 “我们已经看到...

reflection.en: Observing the intricate workings of creation, like the needs of injured penguins, can lead to innovative solutions. This reminds us that wisdom is often found by carefully studying the world around us, as Job teaches: 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you... For the earth will teach you.'
reflection.zh: 观察受造界的精妙运作，例如受伤企鹅的需求，可以带来创新的解决方案。这提醒我们，智慧常常蕴藏在对周遭世界的细致研究之中，正如约伯所教导的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你……地也必指教你。”

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Underwater meadows sustain millions in extreme poverty
title.zh: 海底草甸为数百万赤贫人口提供生计

summary.en: A study provides the first large-scale empirical evidence that seagrass meadows act as a critical safety net for millions of coastal people living in extreme poverty across the Indo-Pacific.
summary.zh: 一项研究首次提供了大规模的实证证据，表明海草床是印度洋-太平洋地区数百万生活在赤贫中的沿海人民的关键安全网。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A study provides the first large-scale empirical evidence that seagrass meadows act as a critical safety net for millions of coastal people living in extreme poverty across the Indo-Pacific.

Led by scientists from Project Seagrass, a seagrass conservation organization, the research found that at least 18 million people in poverty across the Indo-Pacific fish in seagrass meadows, including 6.5 million who are entirely dependent on the habitat for subsistence and fishing-related income.

Seagrasses are flowering plants that form extensive underwater meadows along shallow coastlines. Although less familiar than coral reefs or tropical forests, these meadows support accessible fisheries that can be reached on foot or with limited equipment, making them especially important to households with few alternative sources of food or income. Women and other marginalized groups frequently play central roles in these fisheries.

The research identifies that, across the Indo-Pacific, households in extreme poverty were significantly more likely to be entirely dependent on seagrass meadows for their fishing activities, with seagrass-dependent households earning 23% less than other fishers. The data make visible a population of millions of people in poverty whose livelihoods intersect with a habitat that remains largely absent from poverty, development and conservation agendas.

By linking household-level poverty data with seagrass-proximate population estimates, the study reveals a largely invisible population whose livelihoods are closely tied to one of the world's most overlooked marine habitats. The findings suggest that reliance on seagrass fisheries may reinforce a coastal poverty trap, where households with few alternatives remain dependent on low-income livelihoods connected to vulnerable seagrass ecosystems.

Dr. Benjamin Jones, chief conservation officer at Project Seagrass and one of the lead researchers on the study, said, "This study changes how the world needs to see seagrass. These aren't just meadows for fish, for turtles or carbon. They're hidden safety nets for millions of people. When seagrass disappears, it's not just nature that's lost. Food, income and security disappear with it, often for the people least responsible for its decline and least able to adapt. Seagrass loss is a direct threat to food security, livelihoods and justice across some of the world's most climate-vulnerable coastlines."

The research highlights the importance of integrating seagrass ecosystems into poverty alleviation and sustainable development strategies to break this cycle. Failure to do...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 一项研究提供了第一个大规模的经验证据，证明海草甸对于印度太平洋地区数百万生活在极端贫困中的沿海人民来说是一个重要的安全网。 由海草保护组织“海草计划”的科学家领导的这项研究发现，印度洋-太平洋地区至少有 1800 万贫困人口在海草草地上捕鱼，其中 650 万人完全依赖栖息地维持生计和与渔业相关的收入。 海草是开花植物，沿着浅海岸线形成广阔的水下草甸。尽管不如珊瑚礁或热带森林那么熟悉，但这些草地支持可步行或使用有限设备即可到达的渔业，这使得它们对于缺乏替代食物或收入来源的家庭尤其重要。妇女和其他边缘群体经常在这些渔业中发挥核心作用。 研究发现，在整个印度-太平洋地区，极端贫困家庭更有可能完全依赖海草草甸进行捕鱼活动，依赖海草的家庭收入比其他渔民低 23%。这些数据揭示了数以百万计的贫困人口，他们的生计与基本没有被纳入贫困、发展和保护议程的栖息地交织在一起。 通过将家庭层面的贫困数据与海草附近的人口估计联系起来，该研究揭示了一个很大程度上被忽视的人口，他们的生计与世界上最被忽视的海洋栖息地之一密切相关。研究结果表明，对海草渔业的依赖可能会加剧沿海贫困陷阱，即几乎没有其他选择的家庭仍然依赖与脆弱的海草生态系统相关的低收入生计。 海草项目首席保护官、该研究的主要研究人员之一本杰明·琼斯博士说：“这项研究改变了世界对海草的看法。这些不仅仅是鱼类、海龟或碳的草地。它们是数百万人的隐藏安全网。当海草消失时，失去的不仅仅是自然。食物、收入和安全也随之消失，而这些人往往对海草的减少负有最小的责任，也最没有能力适应。”海草损失对世界上一些气候最脆弱的海岸线的粮食安全、生计和正义构成直接威胁。” 该研究强调了将海草生态系统纳入扶贫和可持续发展战略以打破这一循环的重要性。未能做到...

reflection.en: This research reveals the vital role of seagrass meadows, not just as ecosystems, but as a source of sustenance and income for millions. It reminds us that even in seemingly remote or overlooked natural environments, human lives are deeply intertwined with creation, and the well-being of the vulnerable is often tied to the health of the planet. Matthew...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了海草床的重要作用，它们不仅是生态系统，更是数百万人赖以生存和获取收入的来源。它提醒我们，即使在看似偏远或被忽视的自然环境中，人类的生活也与受造物息息相关，而弱势群体的福祉常常与地球的健康息息相关。 马太福音25:40章提到，服事我们中间最小的，就是服事基督。这项研究表明，一种自然资源如何提供这种基本的服务，维持那些生活在赤贫中的人们。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Why did this Canadian 'island' seemingly vanish and reappear miles away?
title.zh: 加拿大“岛屿”为何看似消失又出现在数英里外？

summary.en: BBC Verify has used satellite imagery to track the floating island in British Columbia, which has surprised people around the world.
summary.zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）的核查部门利用卫星图像追踪了不列颠哥伦比亚省一个漂浮的岛屿，该岛屿的出现令全世界的人们感到惊讶。

body.en:
A floating 'island' in a reservoir in British Columbia has turned up about 20 miles from where it was last spotted, after seeming to vanish in July.

The organisation who manages the reservoir where it was found says at first it thought the discovery was a "hoax".

BBC Verify has used satellite imagery to track its journey and looked into why it travelled so far - as Jake Horton reports.
body.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省一座水库中的一座漂浮“岛屿”在 7 月份似乎消失后，现在又出现在距离上次发现地点约 20 英里的地方。 管理发现水库的组织表示，起初他们认为这一发现是一个“骗局”。 据杰克·霍顿 (Jake Horton) 报道，BBC verify 使用卫星图像来追踪它的旅程，并调查了它为何旅行这么远。

reflection.en: The mysterious journey of a floating island in British Columbia, tracked by satellite imagery, reminds us that the natural world holds many wonders. As Job 12:7-9 suggests, creation itself can teach us profound truths about its Creator and His intricate designs.
reflection.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省一个漂浮岛屿的神秘旅程，通过卫星图像被追踪记录，提醒我们大自然充满了奇妙。正如约伯书12:7-9所言，受造之物本身就能教导我们关于其创造主和祂精妙设计的深刻真理。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: The universe has plenty of hydrogen. So why is star formation collapsing?
title.zh: 宇宙中有充足的氢。那么恒星形成为何在萎缩？

summary.en: Star formation across the universe has fallen dramatically over the past 4.5 billion years, but astronomers have uncovered a surprising twist: the supply of neutral hydrogen, a key ingredient for making stars, has barely declined. Using China’s FAST radio telescope and data from roughly 2.5 million galaxies observed...
summary.zh: 在过去的45亿年里，宇宙中的恒星形成急剧下降，但天文学家们发现了一个令人惊讶的转折：作为制造恒星的关键成分——中性氢的供应量几乎没有减少。利用中国的FAST射电望远镜以及DESI观测到的约250万个星系的数据，研究人员发现，45亿年前的恒星形成率大约是现在的2.5倍，而中性氢的含量仅比现在高约1.4倍。

body.en: Star formation across the universe has fallen dramatically over the past 4.5 billion years, but astronomers have uncovered a surprising twist: the supply of neutral hydrogen, a key ingredient for making stars, has barely declined. Using China’s FAST radio telescope and data from roughly 2.5 million galaxies observed by DESI, researchers found that star formation was about 2.5 times higher 4.5 billion years ago, while neutral hydrogen levels were only about 1.4 times higher.
body.zh: 过去 45 亿年来，宇宙中恒星的形成急剧减少，但天文学家发现了一个令人惊讶的转折：中性氢（形成恒星的关键成分）的供应几乎没有减少。利用中国的FAST射电望远镜和DESI观测到的约250万个星系的数据，研究人员发现，恒星形成量比45亿年前高出约2.5倍，而中性氢水平仅高出约1.4倍。

reflection.en: Astronomers, using powerful instruments like China's FAST radio telescope, are observing the vastness of the cosmos to understand its processes. Their findings about star formation, despite abundant hydrogen, reveal a complex reality. This pursuit of knowledge through observing creation echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself speaks of its Maker's...
reflection.zh: 天文学家们利用中国FAST射电望远镜等强大仪器，观察浩瀚的宇宙以了解其运行规律。他们关于恒星形成的发现，尽管氢气充足，却揭示了一个复杂的现实。这种通过观察受造物来追求知识的努力，呼应了古老的智慧——受造物本身就诉说着其创造者的精妙设计和旨意。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: September brings a dazzling Venus and a glowing Harvest Moon
title.zh: 九月带来璀璨的金星和发光的丰收月

summary.en: September's sky offers celestial wonders including a bright Venus, the hazy center of the Milky Way, and the autumnal equinox. The month concludes with a luminous Harvest Moon appearing near Saturn and Neptune, providing skywatchers with a rich viewing experience.
summary.zh: 九月的夜空为观星者带来了诸多奇观，包括明亮的金星、银河系的朦胧中心以及秋分点。月末，一轮皎洁的丰收月将伴随土星和海王星一同升起，为人们提供丰富的观测机会。

body.en:
September brings a busy lineup for skywatchers, including a dazzling Venus, a Harvest Moon near Saturn and Neptune, the seasonal equinox, and opportunities to use the Moon as a guide to some recognizable stars and Milky Way features.

September offers a little bit of everything in the evening sky. The Moon helps point the way to a celestial teapot, Venus becomes exceptionally bright, the seasons officially turn, and the Harvest Moon appears with two planetary companions.

Between September 14 and 20, the Moon can serve as a useful guide to several notable sights in the night sky. About an hour after sunset, face south and locate the Moon.

Its position will change from one evening to the next as it moves against the more distant background stars. Along the way, it will pass close to Antares.

Antares is a bright reddish star that represents the heart of the constellation Scorpius.

Nearby in the constellation Sagittarius is another easy-to-recognize pattern of stars known as the Teapot. Its stars form a shape that resembles a teapot, including a handle, lid, and spout.

From a location with especially dark skies, you might also notice a faint, cloudy band that appears to rise like steam from the Teapot's spout.

Trace that hazy glow toward its densest region, and you will be looking in the direction of the center of the Milky Way galaxy.

On September 18, turn toward the west to see Venus at peak brilliance during this evening appearance.

The planet should be easy to identify. Not long after sunset, Venus will appear as an intensely bright point of light low above the western horizon, shining more brightly than any star around it. An unobstructed view toward the horizon will make it easier to see before Venus disappears below it.

People around the globe are encouraged to spend time observing our nearest celestial neighbor while learning about lunar science, exploration, and the Moon's influence on cultures throughout history. Find an event near you or learn how to participate from wherever you are at go.nasa.gov/ObserveTheMoon .

On September 22, fall officially begins in the Northern Hemisphere, while spring starts in the Southern Hemisphere.

This date marks the September equinox, when the Sun is positioned directly above Earth's equator and the lengths of day and night are close to equal across much of the planet.

After the equinox, daylight continues to decrease in the Northern Hemisphere while increasing in the Southern Hemisphere.

On September 26, the Harvest Moon becomes the main attraction, rising in the eastern sky shortly after sunset.

Saturn will appear nearby, while the much fainter Neptune forms a broad triangle with Saturn and the Moon.

Saturn is bright enough to see with the unaided eye. Neptune presents more of a challenge. At...
body.zh: 九月为天文观测者带来了繁忙的阵容，包括耀眼的金星、土星和海王星附近的丰收月亮、季节分点，以及利用月球作为一些可识别恒星和银河系特征的指南的机会。 九月的夜空提供了一点点一切。月亮帮助指明了通往天体茶壶的道路，金星变得格外明亮，季节正式转变，收获月与两个行星伙伴一起出现。 9 月 14 日至 20 日期间，月亮可以作为夜空中几个著名景点的有用指南。日落后大约一小时，面向南并找到月亮。 当它相对于更遥远的背景恒星移动时，它的位置会从一个晚上到下一个晚上发生变化。一路上，它将经过心宿二附近。 心宿二是一颗明亮的红色恒星，代表天蝎座的心脏。 人马座附近有另一种易于识别的恒星图案，称为茶壶。它的星星形成一个类似于茶壶的形状，包括手柄、盖子和壶嘴。 从天空特别黑暗的地方，您可能还会注意到一条微弱的云带，看起来像茶壶壶嘴中的蒸汽一样升起。 将朦胧的光芒追踪到其最密集的区域，您将看到银河系中心的方向。 9 月 18 日，转向西方，在今晚的金星出现时看到最耀眼的金星。 这颗行星应该很容易识别。日落后不久，金星将在西方地平线上方以一个强烈明亮的光点出现，比周围的任何恒星都明亮。在金星消失在地平线以下之前，视野开阔，可以更容易地看到地平线。 我们鼓励世界各地的人们花时间观察我们最近的天体邻居，同时了解月球科学、探索以及月球对整个历史文化的影响。查找您附近的活动或了解如何随时随地参与 go.nasa.gov/ObserveTheMoon 。 9月22日，北半球正式进入秋季，南半球正式进入春季。 这一天标志着九月的春分，此时太阳位于地球赤道正上方，地球大部分地区昼夜长度接近相等。 春分之后，北半球的日照继续减少，南半球的日照增加。 9 月 26 日，收获月成为主要景点，在日落后不久从东方天空升起。 土星将出现在附近，而较暗的海王星与土星和月球形成一个宽阔的三角形。 土星足够明亮，可以用肉眼看到。海王星带来了更多的挑战。在...

reflection.en: As September unfolds, the night sky presents a breathtaking display with Venus shining brightly and the Harvest Moon gracing the heavens. These celestial spectacles remind us of the vastness and beauty of creation, echoing the psalmist's declaration that the skies themselves proclaim the glory of Yahweh. Observing these cosmic events can inspire awe and...
reflection.zh: 随着九月的到来，夜空中金星璀璨，丰收月也点缀着苍穹，呈现出令人惊叹的景象。这些天体奇观提醒着我们造物的浩瀚与美丽，正如诗篇所宣告的那样，诸天述说着雅伟的荣耀。 仰望这些宇宙景象，能激发我们的敬畏与惊奇，将我们的目光引向宇宙精妙的秩序与宏伟，这是造物主化工的明证。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
title.zh: 联合国警告厄尔尼诺现象将‘巨变’，各国准备应对影响

summary.en: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.
summary.zh: 世界气象组织（WMO）警告说，这种自然天气现象可能会扰乱全球经济。

body.en:
The world has entered a "danger zone of extreme weather" as the impacts of El Niño start to be felt globally, UN head António Guterres has warned.

The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) has released the latest data on the natural weather phenomenon showing it could be the strongest for more than 70 years and last until at least February 2027.

El Niño changes weather patterns around the world, pushing some regions into drought whilst others experience stronger typhoons and flooding.

Forecasters also say El Niño will boost temperatures in some places, coming on top of rising heat globally from human-induced climate change.

"El Niño is being supersized before our eyes. The science leaves no room for doubt: the planet is in uncharted waters, and those waters are heating up," Guterres said.

The BBC spoke with governments and scientists about the measures being taken globally to reduce the risk of deaths, displacement and environmental damage. Early warning systems have been strengthened and deployment of pre-emptive medical assistance, but the strength of this particular event has raised serious concerns particularly for vulnerable groups.

The WMO - a UN agency - said it has undertaken a "major mobilisation" to try to circulate its forecasts of potential extreme weather events, linked to El Niño, to as many communities as possible.

WMO Secretary-General Celeste Saulo warned: "El Niño has the potential to deliver a massive blow to communities and economies across the world."

El Niño is a natural weather phenomenon that develops in the Pacific Ocean and is linked to a change in wind patterns. It allows warm water to spread eastwards and releases heat into the atmosphere.

Sea temperatures in the central and eastern tropical Pacific have risen sharply in recent months - a clear sign of a strengthening El Niño.

In the Pacific's key monitoring region, surface temperatures have been well over 2C above average in recent weeks, putting it on track to be declared a "very strong" event.

But it is expected to surpass even that marker. Monthly sea surface temperatures could get close to 4C above average, forecasts suggest.

This would make it the strongest El Niño since at least 1950, by potentially a large margin.

Temperatures are even more exceptional below the surface of the Pacific - in places more than 8C above average.

Above-normal sea temperatures are also expected in other parts of the world including the Indian Ocean, tropical Atlantic and around parts of the Australian coast.

With its rich marine life, changes in ocean heat are of particular concern to Australia.

It has been plagued by marine heatwaves in recent years - driven by climate change.

El Niño is a natural phenomenon, but it tends to bring the kind of extreme heat which also...
body.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，随着厄尔尼诺现象的影响开始在全球范围内显现，世界已进入“极端天气的危险区”。 世界气象组织（WMO）发布了有关自然天气现象的最新数据，显示该现象可能是70多年来最强烈的一次，并且至少会持续到2027年2月。 厄尔尼诺现象改变了世界各地的天气模式，使一些地区陷入干旱，而另一些地区则遭受更强的台风和洪水。 预报员还表示，人为气候变化导致全球气温上升，厄尔尼诺现象将使一些地方气温升高。 古特雷斯说：“厄尔尼诺现象在我们眼前变得越来越大。科学不容置疑：地球正处于未知水域，而且这些水域正在升温。” 英国广播公司与各国政府和科学家讨论了全球为降低死亡、流离失所和环境破坏风险而采取的措施。早期预警系统已得到加强，并部署了先发制人的医疗援助，但这一特殊事件的强度引起了严重关切，特别是对弱势群体而言。 联合国机构世界气象组织表示，它已经进行了一次“重大动员”，试图向尽可能多的社区传播与厄尔尼诺现象有关的潜在极端天气事件的预​​报。 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛警告说：“厄尔尼诺现象有可能给世界各地的社区和经济带来巨大打击。” 厄尔尼诺现象是太平洋中发生的一种自然天气现象，与风型的变化有关。它使温水向东扩散，并将热量释放到大气中。 近几个月来，热带太平洋中部和东部的海水温度急剧上升，这是厄尔尼诺现象加强的明显迹象。 在太平洋的关键监测区域，最近几周地表温度远高于平均水平 2 摄氏度，这使得该事件有望被宣布为“非常强烈”的事件。 但预计这一数字甚至会超过这一水平。预测显示，每月海面温度可能比平均水平高出近 4 摄氏度。 这将使其成为至少 1950 年以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象，而且可能大幅领先。 太平洋表面以下的气温甚至比平均水平高出 8 摄氏度以上。 世界其他地区的海水温度预计也会高于正常水平，包括印度洋、热带大西洋和澳大利亚海岸部分地区。 海洋生物丰富，海洋热量的变化引起了澳大利亚的特别关注。 近年来，由于气候变化，它一直受到海洋热浪的困扰。 厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然现象，但它往往会带来极端高温，从而...

reflection.en: The UN warns of a 'supersized' El Niño, a natural phenomenon that will bring extreme weather to many parts of the world. This reminds us of the groaning of creation, as described in Romans 8:22, which longs for renewal. As we face these disruptions, we can pray for resilience and wisdom for those affected, and for a deeper respect for the natural world.
reflection.zh: 联合国警告称，一场‘巨变’的厄尔尼诺现象正在来临，这种自然现象将给世界许多地区带来极端天气。这让我们想起罗马书8章22节所描述的受造之物的叹息，它们渴望更新。当我们面对这些破坏时，我们可以为受影响的人们祈求韧性和智慧，并为更尊重自然世界祈祷。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Widow whose husband died after falling into slurry pit warns of pressure on farmers
title.zh: 丈夫死于粪坑的寡妇警告农民面临的压力

summary.en: Margaret Owen states that 'things are getting worse' following an increase in worker fatalities on British farms. Her husband, Islwyn, died after falling into a slurry pit in 2024, a tragedy that has been brought back to her by the recent deaths of a father and son in similar circumstances. Official figures show 22...
summary.zh: 玛格丽特·欧文表示，“情况正在变得更糟”，此前英国农场工人的死亡人数有所增加。她的丈夫伊斯林于2024年 fall into a slurry pit，这一悲剧因上周一对父子在类似情况下死亡而再次浮现在她脑海中。官方数据显示，2025-26年度有22名农场工人死亡，是十年来最高纪录。

body.en:
The widow of a farmer who died after he fell into a slurry pit has spoken about the stresses facing workers after a rise in deaths.

Margaret Owen said the impact of husband Islwyn's death had been brought back to her once again following reports that a father and son had died in similar circumstances last week.

She said Islwyn had worried about bad weather and recently-introduced rules on slurry spreading when he had fallen at his farm in Bala, Gwynedd, in 2024.

Latest figures from the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) show 22 workers died on British farms during 2025-26 - the highest number in a decade.

Margaret said the number of deaths had made it appear "things are getting worse and worse".

An inquest into Islwyn's death found he had fallen into the slurry pit after he had climbed on to a short wall to adjust some machinery at Cefn Bodig farm in Llanycil, Bala.

He suffered asphyxia along with serious injuries to his right arm and chest caused by the machinery, and his body was found by a neighbour 90 minutes after he was reported missing on the evening of 4 September 2024.

Margaret said that, although it had not been the cause of his death, Islwyn had been under pressure because of a combination of bad weather and the Welsh government's rules that banned farmers from spreading slurry between mid-October to January.

The ban on muck-spreading over winter months to protect rivers is something that Wales' environment minister Llyr Gruffydd has said he wanted to change after Plaid Cymru came into power.

"The weather had been wet and there was a problem with mixing the slurry and emptying the slurry before the cattle came in - it was quite a stressful situation," she told BBC Cymru Fyw.

The deaths of Alan Ford, 72, and his son Rick, 42, after they had fallen into an industrial slurry tank at a farm in Chester on 26 August, had brought back memories of her husband's death, she said.

The 22 deaths of workers on farms in Wales, England and Scotland during 2025-26 was the highest in a decade, and second only to the number of deaths of those working in construction (27), according to HSE figures. , external

But the rate of farm deaths was seven times higher per 100,000 workers, and 21 times more likely than the all-industry average.

"It seems that things are getting worse and worse", Margaret said, and that "four [people] within four miles of here have died in recent years - it's scary isn't it?"

"Islwyn was so careful - one of those rare farmers who wore a helmet," she said.

She said she had known something was wrong on the day Islwyn died "because he was never very late for dinner", and said the nature of his death had been "hard to accept".

Margaret had to sell their farm stock and arrange for other farmers to rent the majority of their...
body.zh: 一名掉入泥浆坑身亡的农民的遗孀谈到了死亡人数上升后工人们面临的压力。 玛格丽特·欧文 (Margaret Owen) 表示，上周有报道称，一对父子在类似情况下死亡，丈夫伊斯文 (Islwyn) 去世的影响再次浮现在她心头。 她说，伊斯文于 2024 年在圭内斯巴拉的农场摔倒，当时他担心恶劣天气，最近出台了关于泥浆扩散的规定。 英国健康与安全执行局 (HSE) 的最新数据显示，2025-26 年间，英国农场有 22 名工人死亡，这是十年来的最高数字。 玛格丽特说，死亡人数表明“情况变得越来越糟”。 对 Islwyn 死亡的调查发现，他在巴拉兰尼西尔的 Cefn Bodig 农场爬上一堵短墙调整一些机械后掉进了泥浆坑。 他因机器造成窒息，右臂和胸部严重受伤，2024 年 9 月 4 日晚，他被报告失踪 90 分钟后，他的尸体被邻居发现。 玛格丽特说，虽然这不是他的死因，但由于恶劣天气和威尔士政府禁止农民在十月中旬至一月期间撒播泥浆的规定，伊斯文一直承受着压力。 威尔士环境部长利尔·格鲁菲德 (Llyr Gruffydd) 表示，在格莱德·西姆鲁 (Plaid Cymru) 上台后，他希望改变冬季月份为保护河流而禁止撒播淤泥的禁令。 她告诉 BBC Cymru Fyw：“天气潮湿，在牛进来之前混合泥浆和清空泥浆存在问题 - 这是一个相当紧张的情况。” 她说，72 岁的艾伦·福特和 42 岁的儿子里克于 8 月 26 日掉进切斯特一家农场的工业泥浆罐后死亡，这让她回想起丈夫的死亡。 根据 HSE 数据，2025-26 年间，威尔士、英格兰和苏格兰农场工人死亡 22 人，为十年来最高，仅次于建筑业工人死亡人数（27 人）。 , external 但每 10 万名工人的农场死亡率高出 7 倍，比全行业平均水平高出 21 倍。 玛格丽特说，“情况似乎变得越来越糟”，“近年来，这里四英里范围内有四个人死亡——这很可怕不是吗？” “伊斯文非常小心——他是罕见的戴头盔的农民之一，”她说。 她说，伊斯文去世的那天，她就知道出了什么问题，“因为他吃晚饭从来没有迟到过”，并表示他的死亡性质“难以接受”。 玛格丽特不得不卖掉他们的农场库存并安排其他农民租用他们的大部分...

reflection.en: The tragic death of Islwyn Owen, and the subsequent warning from his widow Margaret, underscores the immense pressures faced by farmers. The rising number of fatalities, including Islwyn's, highlights a systemic vulnerability. In the face of such hardship and loss, we are called to advocate for those whose livelihoods are precarious and whose voices may be...
reflection.zh: 伊斯林·欧文的悲惨去世以及他的遗孀玛格丽特发出的警告，凸显了农民面临的巨大压力。包括伊斯林在内的死亡人数不断增加，表明存在系统性的脆弱性。面对这样的困境和损失，我们被呼召去为那些生计艰难、在挣扎中可能被忽视的声音发声。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Biodegradable 'nanobone' could one day help regrow bone without painful grafts
title.zh: 一种可生物降解的“纳米骨”有一天可能无需痛苦的移植即可帮助再生骨骼

summary.en: For children born with cleft lip and palate, repairing gaps in the jawbone often means waiting until they are 10 to 12 years old before undergoing invasive bone graft surgery. University of Sydney researchers have developed a biodegradable "nanobone" material that allows the body to harness its own healing properties...
summary.zh: 对于天生有唇裂和腭裂的儿童来说，修复颌骨缺损通常意味着要等到10至12岁才能进行侵入性的骨移植手术。悉尼大学的研究人员开发了一种可生物降解的“纳米骨”材料，该材料能让身体利用自身的愈合特性来再生骨骼，为一项50多年来变化不大的手术提供了一种潜在的未来替代方案。

body.en: For children born with cleft lip and palate, repairing gaps in the jawbone often means waiting until they are 10 to 12 years old before undergoing invasive bone graft surgery. University of Sydney researchers have developed a biodegradable "nanobone" material that allows the body to harness its own healing properties to regrow bone, offering a potential future alternative to procedures that have changed little in more than 50 years.
body.zh: 对于先天唇腭裂的儿童来说，修复颌骨间隙通常意味着要等到 10 至 12 岁时才进行侵入性骨移植手术。悉尼大学的研究人员开发了一种可生物降解的“纳米骨”材料，可以让身体利用自身的愈合特性来再生骨骼，为未来 50 多年来几乎没有改变的手术提供了潜在的替代方案。

reflection.en: The pursuit of healing and restoration is a deeply human endeavor, reflecting a desire to mend what is broken. The researchers' decade of work on this 'nanobone' material embodies the patient, diligent acquisition of knowledge that can bring relief and hope to many.
reflection.zh: 追求治愈和修复是人类的根本愿望，体现了修补破碎之物的渴望。研究人员十年如一日地投入到这种“纳米骨”材料的研发中，体现了耐心、勤奋地获取知识的精神，这能为许多人带来慰藉和希望。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.zh: 减缓气候变化的捷径。为什么不是每个人都在这样做？——播客

We definitely don’t want this gas spewing needlessly into the atmosphere, but in 2023 that’s exactly what environment editor Damian Carrington found was...

body.en: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that traps more than 80 times as much heat than carbon dioxide over a 20-year period and causes 25% of global heating today. We definitely don’t want this gas spewing needlessly into the atmosphere, but in 2023 that’s exactly what environment editor Damian Carrington found was happening when he reported on 1,000 super-emitting methane leaks across the globe. Now Turkmenistan, the worst country for mega-leaks, has begun to plug them. Damian tells Madeleine Finlay why some experts call stopping leaks the climate ‘emergency brake’ and reveals which countries are still failing to act ‘Breakthrough’ as Turkmenistan starts fixing ‘mindboggling’ methane mega-leaks Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 甲烷是一种强效温室气体，在 20 年内吸收的热量是二氧化碳的 80 多倍，导致当今全球变暖的 25%。我们绝对不希望这种气体不必要地喷入大气中，但 2023 年环境编辑达米安·卡林顿 (Damian Carrington) 在报告全球 1,000 起超排放甲烷泄漏事件时发现，这种情况正在发生。现在，土库曼斯坦这个超级泄漏最严重的国家已经开始堵住这些泄漏。达米安告诉玛德琳·芬利，为什么一些专家将阻止泄漏称为气候“紧急刹车”，并揭示了当土库曼斯坦开始修复“令人难以置信的”甲烷特大泄漏时，哪些国家仍未采取“突破”行动支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that Turkmenistan is beginning to plug methane leaks offers a glimmer of hope in the fight against climate change. This action aligns with the biblical mandate to care for creation, recognizing our responsibility to steward the Earth and its resources wisely. May this be a catalyst for greater global cooperation in protecting our shared home.
reflection.zh: 土库曼斯坦开始堵漏的消息为应对气候变化带来了希望的曙光。这一行动符合圣经中关爱造物的吩咐，认识到我们有责任明智地管理地球及其资源。愿这成为全球加强合作、保护我们共同家园的催化剂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: With education technology, engagement is not the same as learning
title.zh: 教育技术：参与不等于学习

summary.en: A new report from the American Psychological Association cautions that student engagement with educational technology, particularly generative AI, does not equate to genuine learning. These AI tools risk enhancing immediate performance while hindering the development of fundamental knowledge and skills, as measured by...
summary.zh: 美国心理学会的一份新报告警告说，学生对教育技术的参与，特别是生成式人工智能，并不等同于真正的学习。这些人工智能工具可能会提高即时表现，但会阻碍基础知识和技能的发展，而衡量学习的标准是能否在数字环境之外应用所学知识。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A new report from the American Psychological Association warns that student engagement with educational technology is not the same as learning—and that generative AI tools pose particular risks by improving students' immediate performance without building their underlying knowledge or skills.

The APA Expert Report on Children's and Adolescents' Learning with Educational Technology argues that students' ability to apply new knowledge outside an app or screen is a much stronger indication of learning than how much time a child spends on a screen. It says parents and educators working with children and young people ages 5 to 18 should be wary of marketing claims that run ahead of scientific evidence.

The report stresses that even if a student is paying close attention to an app, such as by clicking frequently, responding to animations or interacting with rewards, that engagement does not necessarily mean the student is learning.

"Educational technology has the potential to profoundly advance students' learning and abilities, but parents, teachers and school districts need tools that are safe, supported by evidence and can genuinely help students learn," said APA CEO Arthur C. Evans Jr.

"These recommendations, based on psychological research, can help determine whether EdTech tools actually produce the learning outcomes they promise."

Compiled by a multidisciplinary panel of cognitive and educational psychologists, learning scientists and EdTech experts, the report synthesizes evidence across a wide range of technologies, including educational apps, games, intelligent tutoring systems, generative AI tools and digital learning platforms.

It offers 10 evidence-based recommendations to help families, educators, policymakers and developers ensure that technology promotes meaningful learning.

Drawing on research from psychological science, the report recommends that schools, families and developers prioritize tools that build durable knowledge and skills students can carry into other contexts, instead of evaluating apps based on flashy features. Additional recommendations include making adult involvement a significant part of EdTech implementation and investing in research that can keep pace with rapid technological change.

Educators should exercise particular caution when introducing generative AI tools into learning environments, said Nicole Barnes, APA's executive lead psychologist for education.

"AI can help a student produce a better essay, but the improved final product does not necessarily mean the student has become a better writer," Barnes said.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 美国心理学会的一份新报告警告说，学生对教育技术的参与与学习不同，生成式人工智能工具会在不构建学生基础知识或技能的情况下提高学生的即时表现，从而带来特殊的风险。 APA 关于儿童和青少年利用教育技术学习的专家报告认为，学生在应用程序或屏幕之外应用新知识的能力比孩子在屏幕上花费的时间更能表明学习情况。报告称，从事 5 至 18 岁儿童和青少年工作的家长和教育工作者应该警惕那些领先于科学证据的营销宣传。 该报告强调，即使学生密切关注应用程序，例如频繁点击、响应动画或与奖励互动，这种参与并不一定意味着学生正在学习。 APA 首席执行官 Arthur C. reflection.en: The rapid advance of educational technology, including generative AI, presents a complex challenge. While these tools can boost immediate results, the APA report highlights a crucial distinction: engagement is not the same as deep learning. We must discern whether technology truly builds understanding or merely offers a superficial gloss, echoing the wisdom...
reflection.zh: 教育技术，包括生成式人工智能的快速发展，带来了复杂的挑战。虽然这些工具可以提高即时成果，但美国心理学会的报告强调了一个关键区别：参与感不等于深度学习。我们必须辨别技术是真正地构建了理解，还是仅仅提供了肤浅的润饰，这呼应了“凡事都可行，但不都有益”的智慧，尤其是在持久成长方面。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: ADHD may have a surprising creative advantage
title.zh: ADHD 可能具有令人惊讶的创造性优势

summary.en: New research suggests that some attention patterns associated with ADHD, such as defocused attention, might actually foster creativity by enabling the brain to explore more ideas and make unexpected connections. This research examines the neurological link between attention and creativity, proposing that these traits...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的一些注意力模式，例如“非聚焦性注意”，可能通过让大脑探索更多想法和建立意外联系来促进创造力。这项研究探讨了注意力和创造力之间的神经学联系，并提出这些特质可以在创造性活动中得到富有成效的引导。

body.en:
ADHD affects millions of people and can make everyday tasks involving focus, impulse control, and sustained attention more difficult. At the same time, traits associated with ADHD are also found among highly successful artists and innovators, including Justin Timberlake and Simone Biles. New research from Constructor University neuroscientist Dr. Radwa Khalil examines the science behind this apparent contradiction.

Published in iScience , the research explores the neurological overlap between attention and creativity. It suggests that some mental processes linked to ADHD, including defocused attention, may also support creative thinking when they are directed in productive ways. The findings point to the possibility that creative activities such as art, music, and dance could eventually serve as non-pharmacological interventions for the nearly 8% of children worldwide affected by ADHD.

The study, co-authored by researchers from several prestigious French research institutions, reflects a broader effort to reconsider how ADHD is understood.

"There's a tendency to view attention-related conditions like ADHD purely through the lens of deficit: what is wrong, what is missing, or what needs to be fixed?" said Dr. Khalil.

Although ADHD is commonly approached as a disorder defined by difficulties, Khalil said emerging research shows that attention and creativity rely on some of the same neural networks.

"Neurodivergent attention patterns, then, are not merely problems. They can open pathways to powerful creative thinking when directed appropriately," she said.

The work, titled Attention Unleashed: creative therapy for thoughtful transformation , brings together findings from multiple research fields to show how the brain systems involved in attention also overlap with those involved in creativity.

The researchers highlight free-associative thought as one example of this connection. The ability to let ideas move in unexpected directions can contribute to creative insights, but similar patterns are also associated with distractibility, mind-wandering, and other behaviors frequently seen in ADHD.

"Think of attention like a spotlight. Most people are able to focus their beam on one thing. ADHD brains have a wider spotlight, taking in more information at once. This condition can make routine tasks that require focus challenging. However, this broader view, or 'defocused attention', also encourages exploratory thinking and new idea combinations, which fuel creativity."

In other words, a broader attentional field can create difficulties when a task demands concentration on a single goal. But that same tendency to absorb more information and move among different ideas may encourage exploration and make it easier to form unexpected connections.

Khalil and...
body.zh: 注意力缺陷多动症（ADHD）影响数百万人，并使涉及注意力、冲动控制和持续注意力的日常任务变得更加困难。与此同时，在非常成功的艺术家和创新者中也发现了与多动症相关的特征，包括贾斯汀·汀布莱克和西蒙·拜尔斯。建设大学神经科学家拉德瓦·哈利勒博士的新研究探讨了这一明显矛盾背后的科学依据。 该研究发表在 iScience 上，探讨了注意力和创造力之间的神经重叠。它表明，一些与多动症相关的心理过程，包括注意力分散，如果以富有成效的方式进行指导，也可能支持创造性思维。研究结果表明，艺术、音乐和舞蹈等创造性活动最终可能成为全球近 8% 患有多动症的儿童的非药物干预措施。 这项研究由法国几家著名研究机构的研究人员共同撰写，反映了重新考虑如何理解多动症的更广泛努力。 “人们倾向于纯粹通过缺陷的视角来看待与注意力相关的疾病，例如注意力缺陷多动症：哪里出了问题，缺少什么，或者需要解决什么？”卡里尔博士说。 尽管多动症通常被视为一种由困难定义的疾病，但哈利勒说，新兴研究表明注意力和创造力依赖于一些相同的神经网络。 “因此，神经发散的注意力模式不仅仅是问题。如果指导得当，它们可以开辟通向强大创造性思维的途径，”她说。 这项名为“注意力释放：深思熟虑转变的创造性疗法”的工作汇集了多个研究领域的发现，展示了涉及注意力的大脑系统如何与涉及创造力的大脑系统重叠。 研究人员强调自由联想思想是这种联系的一个例子。让想法朝意想不到的方向发展的能力有助于产生创造性的见解，但类似的模式也与注意力分散、走神和其他多动症中常见的行为有关。 “把注意力想象成聚光灯。大多数人能够将注意力集中在一件事情上。多动症的大脑有更广泛的聚光灯，可以一次吸收更多信息。这种情况可能会使需要集中注意力的日常任务变得具有挑战性。然而，这种更广泛的视野，或‘分散注意力’，也鼓励探索性思维和新想法组合，从而激发创造力。” 换句话说，当任务需要集中于单一目标时，更广泛的注意力领域可能会带来困难。但吸收更多信息并在不同想法之间转换的同样倾向可能会鼓励探索，并更容易形成意想不到的联系。 卡里尔和...

reflection.en: The relentless pace of modern life often feels like a race for ever-increasing knowledge and understanding, as described in Daniel 12:4. This research on ADHD offers a different perspective, suggesting that even patterns of 'defocused attention' can lead to creative breakthroughs. It reminds us that wisdom isn't always found in intense focus, but sometimes...
reflection.zh: 但以理书12:4描述了末世知识和理解的增长，而现代生活的快节奏似乎也印证了这一点。这项关于ADHD的研究提供了一个不同的视角，表明即使是“非聚焦性注意”的模式也能带来创造性的突破。它提醒我们，智慧并非总是在高度专注中找到，有时也存在于我们的大脑在被允许游离时所建立的意外联系之中。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Study reveals distinct patterns across single-, multi-, and mass homicides
title.zh: 研究揭示单人、多人和大规模凶杀案的独特模式

summary.en: An updated analysis of U.S. homicide data reveals that intimate partner violence (IPV) frequently precedes mass homicides and is also associated with multi-victim and single-victim deaths. The study categorizes homicides into single-victim, multi-victim (2-3 victims), and mass (4+ victims) fatalities, noting distinct...
summary.zh: 对美国凶杀案数据的最新分析显示，亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）常常是导致大规模凶杀案的先兆，并且也与多受害者和单受害者死亡案相关。该研究将凶杀案分为单受害者、多受害者（2-3名受害者）和大规模（4名及以上受害者）死亡案，并指出其独特的人口统计特征和具体情况，有助于制定预防凶杀案的策略。

body.en: An updated analysis of U.S. homicide data has found that intimate partner violence (IPV) often precipitates mass homicide and is also frequently associated with multi-victim and single-victim deaths. The study categorizes homicides into single-victim, multi-victim (2–3 victims) and mass (4 or more victims, excluding the perpetrator) fatalities, revealing distinct demographics and circumstances. The findings of the study published in Annals of Epidemiology, can help inform the development of tailored strategies to prevent homicide.
body.zh: 对美国凶杀数据的最新分析发现，亲密伴侣暴力 (IPV) 往往会引发大规模凶杀案，并且还经常导致多名受害者和单一受害者死亡。该研究将凶杀案分为单一受害者、多名受害者（2-3 名受害者）和集体死亡（4 名或更多受害者，不包括肇事者），揭示了不同的人口统计数据和情况。发表在《流行病学年鉴》上的研究结果可以帮助制定预防凶杀案的定制策略。

reflection.en: This study's stark findings connect intimate partner violence to broader patterns of lethal violence, including mass shootings. It underscores the urgent need to protect those experiencing abuse, for their safety is intrinsically linked to the safety of the wider community. Yahweh calls us to defend the oppressed and seek justice for the vulnerable.
reflection.zh: 这项研究的严峻发现将亲密伴侣暴力与包括大规模枪击事件在内的更广泛的致命暴力模式联系起来。它强调了保护遭受虐待者的紧迫性，因为他们的安全与整个社区的安全密不可分。雅伟呼召我们为受压迫者辩护，为弱势群体寻求公义。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Scientists may have found first hint of dark matter
title.zh: 科学家可能已发现暗物质的第一个迹象

summary.en: Scientists believe they may be one step closer to detecting dark matter for the first time, but the findings have not been verified by independent researchers. The material is thought to make up over 85% of the universe and has eluded detection for nearly a century.
summary.zh: 科学家们认为他们可能更接近于首次探测到暗物质，但这些发现尚未得到独立研究人员的核实。这种物质被认为占宇宙的85%以上，近一个世纪以来一直难以被探测到。

body.en:
Scientists believe they may be one step closer to detecting dark matter for the first time, but the findings have not been verified by independent researchers.

Scientists from the University of Bristol were part of a two-year study to try and measure the invisible substance thought to make up over 85% of the universe.

Using a sensitive detector in an an underground laboratory in the US, the researchers saw an atom and mystery particle colliding.

Lead researcher physicist Dr Sam Eriksen said it could be "the first step in understanding dark matter as a particle", but further research could also reveal that the particle is not related to dark matter.

"Following a huge amount of scientific effort, this is incredibly exciting," the University of Bristol senior research associate added.

Although scientists have long been certain of the existence of dark matter, because it is invisible as it reflects no light.

While it is thought to make up the majority of mass in the universe, it has never been directly detected.

For two years, 250 scientists and engineers from 39 institutions spanning six countries, including two universities from the UK, have rigorously scrutinised data from one of the world's most sensitive dark matter detectors called LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ).

It is managed by the US Department of Energy's Sanford Underground Research Facility in South Dakota - the deepest laboratory in the US at nearly a mile beneath the ground.

To search for dark matter, LZ uses extremely sensitive light detectors to capture particle interactions.

The study found one particle interaction which could potentially have been caused by a Weakly Interacting Massive Particle, (WIMP), which scientists believe make up dark matter.

But there is currently low statistical evidence in it being a true breakthrough.

The findings were revealed at a conference in Japan on Tuesday, but the research has yet to undergo peer-review by other scientists.

The findings have been rated 2.6 sigma, which is the system that marks the statistical significance of discoveries. The normal threshold is five.

"With only one event, we don't want to get ahead of ourselves," said Professor Rick Gaitskell from Brown University.

"We are not claiming to have seen dark matter. But we have seen something interesting that we want to share with the scientific community for their input."

Professor Henning Flaecher, an experimental particle physicist at the University of Bristol, said a "huge amount" of work had been carried out over "countless hours" to investigate any previously known reasons researchers might have observed the unusual reaction.

"It's an incredibly exciting time, the kind of event every astro-particle physicist dreams of, and we can't wait to analyse more data to see if additional...
body.zh: 科学家认为，他们可能距离首次探测暗物质又近了一步，但这一发现尚未得到独立研究人员的证实。 布里斯托大学的科学家参与了一项为期两年的研究，试图测量这种被认为占宇宙 85% 以上的无形物质。 研究人员在美国地下实验室使用灵敏探测器，看到了原子和神秘粒子的碰撞。 首席研究员物理学家萨姆·埃里克森博士表示，这可能是“将暗物质理解为粒子的第一步”，但进一步的研究也可能揭示该粒子与暗物质无关。 “经过大量的科学努力，这是非常令人兴奋的，”布里斯托大学高级研究员补充道。 尽管科学家们早已确定暗物质的存在，但因为它不反射光，所以是不可见的。 虽然它被认为构成了宇宙中的大部分质量，但它从未被直接探测到。 两年来，来自六个国家 39 个机构（包括两所英国大学）的 250 名科学家和工程师严格审查了来自世界上最灵敏的暗物质探测器之一 LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) 的数据。 它由美国能源部位于南达科他州的桑福德地下研究设施管理，该设施是美国最深的实验室，位于地下近一英里处。 为了寻找暗物质，LZ 使用极其灵敏的光探测器来捕捉粒子相互作用。 该研究发现一种粒子相互作用可能是由弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）引起的，科学家认为它构成了暗物质。 但目前很少有统计证据表明它是真正的突破。 该研究结果于周二在日本举行的一次会议上公布，但该研究尚未经过其他科学家的同行评审。 研究结果的评级为 2.6 sigma，该系统标志着发现的统计显着性。正常阈值是五。 布朗大学的里克·盖茨克尔教授说：“只有一项活动，我们不想超出自己的预期。” “我们并不是声称看到了暗物质。但我们看到了一些有趣的东西，我们希望与科学界分享，以征求他们的意见。” 布里斯托大学实验粒子物理学家亨宁·弗莱彻教授表示，已经在“无数个小时”内进行了“大量”工作，以调查研究人员可能观察到这种不寻常反应的任何先前已知原因。 “这是一个令人难以置信的激动人心的时刻，是每个天体粒子物理学家都梦想的事件，我们迫不及待地想分析更多数据，看看是否还有更多……

reflection.en: For nearly a century, scientists have sought to understand dark matter, the invisible substance comprising most of the universe. Their recent, though unverified, potential detection highlights humanity's persistent quest for knowledge through observing the cosmos. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air,...
reflection.zh: 近一个世纪以来，科学家们一直致力于了解暗物质，这种构成宇宙大部分的看不见的物质。他们最近的潜在探测，尽管尚未得到证实，但凸显了人类通过观察宇宙来不懈追求知识的努力。正如约伯书12:7-9所提醒的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你；或对大地说话，它会教导你；海中的鱼，它们会向你解释。”...

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: US medical groups urge people to get flu and Covid shots in counter to Trump guidance
title.zh: 美国医学团体呼吁接种流感和新冠疫苗，以对抗特朗普的指导方针

summary.en: Leading US medical groups are urging people to get updated flu and Covid-19 vaccinations this fall, banding together to issue shot guidelines and highlight the science behind them, aiming to ease confusion caused by the Trump administration’s changing immunization advice.
summary.zh: 美国顶尖医学团体正在敦促人们在今年秋季接种更新的流感和新冠疫苗，他们联合发布了疫苗接种指南，并强调其背后的科学依据，旨在缓解特朗普政府不断变化的免疫接种建议所造成的困惑。

body.en: Top medical groups band together to ease confusion from Trump administration’s changing immunization advice Leading US medical groups are urging people to get updated flu and Covid-19 vaccinations this fall, banding together on Wednesday to issue shot guidelines – and highlight the science behind them – saying they hope to ease confusion caused by the Trump administration’s changing advice. Flu vaccinations are beginning and the latest coronavirus shots are starting to arrive after the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved this year’s updated versions last week. Winter also brings another vaccine-preventable risk called RSV. Continue reading...
body.zh: 顶级医疗团体联合起来，以缓解特朗普政府不断变化的免疫建议带来的困惑美国主要医疗团体敦促人们在今年秋天接种最新的流感和 Covid-19 疫苗，并于周三联合发布疫苗接种指南，并强调其背后的科学依据，表示他们希望缓解因特朗普政府不断变化的建议而造成的混乱。在美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 上周批准了今年的更新版本后，流感疫苗接种工作已经开始，最新的冠状病毒疫苗也开始上市。冬季还带来了另一种可以通过疫苗预防的风险，即 RSV。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In times of shifting public health guidance, clear, science-based advice is crucial. The collaboration of medical groups to offer unified recommendations demonstrates the value of seeking and heeding expert counsel, especially when navigating complex health decisions. This collective effort aims to bring clarity and confidence to the public.
reflection.zh: 在公共卫生指导方针不断变化的时期，清晰、基于科学的建议至关重要。医学团体联合起来提供统一的建议，这体现了在应对复杂的健康决策时，寻求和听取专家意见的价值。这种集体努力旨在为公众带来清晰和信心。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Interstellar solar sails hit a strange problem at 75% of light speed
title.zh: 星际太阳帆在光速的75%时遇到奇怪的问题

summary.en: Solar sails propelled by powerful lasers could achieve incredible speeds, but relativity might eventually cause the light itself to impede them. At approximately 75% of the speed of light, scattered photons can create drag, presenting a surprising obstacle to interstellar travel.
summary.zh: 由强大激光驱动的太阳帆可以达到惊人的速度，但相对论最终可能会使光本身成为阻碍。在光速的75%左右，散射的光子会产生阻力，为星际旅行带来了令人惊讶的障碍。

body.en:
Reaching another star within a practical amount of time will require something far more capable than chemical rockets. One of the leading ideas is a solar sail, a large reflective structure that can be pushed by light. If extremely powerful lasers are aimed at such a sail, they could accelerate it to speeds well beyond what current propulsion systems can achieve.

But there may be an unexpected problem once a lightsail begins traveling at a significant fraction of the speed of light. According to a new paper on arXiv by Chao Shen and Jiaze Li of the Harbin Institute of Technology, the same light used to propel the sail could eventually produce a drag effect.

The researchers separate the forces produced by photons striking a solar sail into three categories.

The strongest contribution comes from incident light (that raw momentum of the photons hitting the sail). Next is specular reflection (momentum imparted when photons bounce perfectly off the sail). The weakest contribution comes from diffuse scattering (momentum from photons that are absorbed by the sail then reemitted in random directions).

At relatively low speeds, these effects all contribute to pushing the sail forward. The situation becomes much more complicated once the spacecraft reaches relativistic velocities.

As the sail races away from the laser source, the light reaching it undergoes an increasingly strong Doppler shift. The frequency of the incoming light decreases, reducing the amount of thrust produced by all three components.

As a result, continued acceleration becomes progressively less efficient. The faster the sail travels, the harder it becomes for the laser to keep increasing its speed.

The situation changes even more dramatically once the lightsail reaches about 75% of the speed of light.

At that speed, relativistic light aberration becomes important. From the viewpoint of a stationary observer on Earth, diffusely scattered light begins to be directed forward, toward the direction in which the sail is traveling.

Because every action has an equal and opposite reaction, that forward-directed radiation produces a force in the opposite direction. This means diffuse scattering (admittedly the weakest of the three forces) begins acting as drag once the sail passes roughly 75% of the speed of light.

The laser is still pushing the sail forward overall, so the total force does not become negative. However, the efficiency of the propulsion system drops substantially.

The study is focused specifically on radiative dynamics. It does not include nonradiative effects such as collisions and drag from interstellar gas or dust.

It also leaves out the thermal limits of real sail materials. A sail exposed to an extremely powerful laser could potentially overheat or even melt.

For...
body.zh: 在实际时间内到达另一颗恒星将需要比化学火箭能力更强的东西。其中一个领先的想法是太阳帆，这是一种可以由光推动的大型反射结构。如果极其强大的激光瞄准这样的帆，它们可以将其加速到远远超出当前推进系统所能达到的速度。 但一旦光帆开始以光速的很大一部分行驶，可能会出现意想不到的问题。根据哈尔滨工业大学沉超和李嘉泽在 arXiv 上发表的一篇新论文，用于推进帆的相同光最终可能会产生阻力效果。 研究人员将光子撞击太阳帆产生的力分为三类。 最强的贡献来自入射光（光子撞击帆的原始动量）。接下来是镜面反射（当光子从帆上完美反弹时产生的动量）。最弱的贡献来自漫散射（被帆吸收然后以随机方向重新发射的光子的动量）。 在相对较低的速度下，这些效应都有助于推动帆前进。一旦航天器达到相对论速度，情况就会变得更加复杂。 当帆远离激光源时，到达它的光会经历越来越强的多普勒频移。入射光的频率降低，从而减少了所有三个部件产生的推力。 结果，持续加速的效率逐渐降低。帆行进的速度越快，激光就越难保持其速度。 一旦光帆达到光速的 75% 左右，情况就会发生更大的变化。 在这样的速度下，相对论光像差变得很重要。从地球上静止的观察者的角度来看，漫散射光开始向前引导，朝向帆行驶的方向。 因为每个动作都有相等且相反的反应，所以向前的辐射会产生相反方向的力。这意味着一旦帆经过大约 75% 的光速，漫散射（公认的三种力中最弱的一种）就开始充当阻力。 激光仍然在整体上推动帆前进，因此总力不会变成负值。然而，推进系统的效率大幅下降。 该研究特别关注辐射动力学。它不包括非辐射效应，例如星际气体或尘埃的碰撞和阻力。 它还忽略了真实帆材料的热限制。暴露在极其强大的激光下的帆可能会过热甚至融化。 为了...

reflection.en: Humanity's quest to explore the stars, as described in this report on solar sails, is a testament to our God-given curiosity and ingenuity. Yet, as we push the boundaries of physics, we encounter the universe's intricate laws, reminding us that even our most advanced knowledge is still unfolding. The prophet Daniel foresaw a time when 'knowledge shall...
reflection.zh: 人类探索星辰的追求，正如这篇关于太阳帆的报道所述，证明了我们上帝所赐的好奇心和创造力。然而，当我们突破物理学的界限时，我们会遇到宇宙错综复杂的定律，这提醒我们，即使是我们最先进的知识仍在不断发展。先知但以理预见到一个“知识必增长”的时代——这恰如其分地描述了我们持续的科学探索。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Money problems may age your brain faster
title.zh: 金钱问题可能加速您的大脑衰老

summary.en: New research indicates that enduring financial difficulties in early and middle adulthood are associated with diminished cognitive abilities and increased signs of brain aging by later life. The study suggests that chronic stress and worry stemming from financial hardship may progressively harm the brain.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，成年早期和中期持续的经济困难与晚年认知能力下降和大脑衰老迹象增加有关。研究表明，经济困难带来的慢性压力和担忧可能逐渐损害大脑。

body.en:
Persistent financial hardship may speed up age-related cognitive decline, according to new research led by University College London (UCL).

Published in Innovation in Aging , the study analyzed information from 2,759 people in the UK who completed questionnaires across much of their lives through the MRC National Survey of Health and Development (also known as the 1946 British cohort study).

Researchers found that people who faced ongoing financial difficulties or persistently low income during early and middle adulthood tended to perform worse on cognitive tests by the age of 53.

Among a subgroup who later underwent brain scans, persistent low income was also associated with poorer brain health (including more brain shrinkage) in later life (ages 69 to 71).

These associations remained after the researchers accounted for other factors that could have influenced the results, including childhood cognitive ability, education level and childhood disadvantage.

Corresponding author Dr. Jacques Wels (Unit for Lifelong Health & Ageing at UCL) said: "Most studies on cognitive aging look at financial hardship at only a single point in time. Our study using several decades of data allows us to see that it is the accumulation of hardship over many years that is linked to the worst cognitive health outcomes, rather than occasional episodes of adversity."

Senior author Professor Praveetha Patalay (Unit for Lifelong Health & Ageing and Centre for Longitudinal Studies, UCL) said: "Our findings suggest that supporting people facing financial hardship and reducing chronic poverty could also help prevent cognitive decline and dementia cases in the future."

The relationship between financial adversity and poorer brain health later in life appeared especially strong among men, people who had experienced childhood disadvantage, and those who carried APOE-ε4, a genetic variant associated with an increased risk of Alzheimer's disease.

Men who experienced persistent financial adversity also performed worse on cognitive tests at age 53 than their female counterparts.

The researchers suggested several possible explanations for this difference. Disadvantaged men may have been more likely than disadvantaged women to engage in unhealthy behaviors (such as smoking and alcohol misuse). Men in this generation may also have experienced financial strain differently because they were more likely to have been the primary breadwinners in this cohort born in 1946.

Several biological and psychological pathways could help explain the connection between financial hardship and cognitive aging.

One possibility is inflammation. Chronic stress can promote inflammation, which is known to contribute to faster brain aging.

Persistent concern about finances could also increase...
body.zh: 伦敦大学学院（UCL）领导的最新研究表明，持续的经济困难可能会加速与年龄相关的认知能力下降。 该研究发表在《老龄化创新》杂志上，分析了 2,759 名英国人的信息，这些人通过 MRC 国家健康与发展调查（也称为 1946 年英国队列研究）完成了一生中大部分时间的调查问卷。 研究人员发现，在成年早期和中期面临持续经济困难或持续低收入的人到 53 岁时在认知测试中往往表现较差。 在后来接受脑部扫描的一个亚群中，持续的低收入也与晚年（69 至 71 岁）大脑健康状况较差（包括更多的大脑萎缩）有关。 在研究人员考虑了可能影响结果的其他因素（包括儿童认知能力、教育水平和儿童劣势）后，这些关联仍然存在。 通讯作者雅克·韦尔斯博士（伦敦大学学院终身健康与老龄化部门）表示：“大多数关于认知衰老的研究只着眼于单个时间点的经济困难。我们使用数十年数据的研究使我们看到，与最糟糕的认知健康结果相关的是多年困难的积累，而不是偶尔的逆境。” 资深作者 Praveetha Patalay 教授（伦敦大学学院终身健康与老龄化部门和纵向研究中心）表示：“我们的研究结果表明，支持面临经济困难的人们和减少长期贫困也有助于预防未来的认知能力下降和痴呆症病例。” 经济逆境与晚年大脑健康状况不佳之间的关系在男性、童年经历过不利条件的人和携带 APOE-ε4（一种与阿尔茨海默氏病风险增加相关的基因变异）的人中显得尤其强烈。 经历持续的经济逆境的男性在 53 岁时的认知测试中也表现得比女性同行更差。 研究人员对这种差异提出了几种可能的解释。弱势男性可能比弱势女性更有可能从事不健康行为（例如吸烟和酗酒）。这一代的男性也可能经历了不同的经济压力，因为他们更有可能是 1946 年出生的这一代人中的主要养家糊口者。 一些生物和心理途径可以帮助解释经济困难和认知衰老之间的联系。 一种可能性是炎症。慢性压力会促进炎症，众所周知，炎症会加速大脑老化。 对财务状况的持续担忧也可能会增加......

reflection.en: This study highlights how persistent financial struggles can take a tangible toll on our cognitive health, accelerating brain aging. It serves as a somber reminder of the profound impact of our circumstances on our well-being, urging us to seek wisdom in how we navigate life's challenges and value our time.
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调，持续的经济困境会对我们的认知健康造成切实的损害，加速大脑衰老。它警示我们，生活环境对身心健康的深远影响，并促使我们在应对生活挑战和珍惜时光时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Astronauts set out on rare all-female spacewalk
title.zh: 宇航员进行罕见的首次全女性太空行走

summary.en: For the sixth time in history, a team of two women completed a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.
summary.zh: 历史上第六次，一支由两名女性组成的团队完成了在国际空间站外的太空行走。

reflection.en: Two women ventured into the vastness of space, a testament to human ingenuity and collaboration. In the face of the immense cosmos, we are reminded of the psalmist's wonder: 'What is man that you are mindful of him?' Yet, in this very act of exploration, humanity asserts its unique place and God-given dignity.
reflection.zh: 两位女性踏入了浩瀚的太空，这是人类智慧与协作的证明。面对浩瀚的宇宙，我们被提醒诗人的惊叹：“人算什么，你竟顾念他？”然而，正是通过这次探索，人类彰显了其独特的地位和雅伟所赐予的尊严。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: Almost half of world’s farmers poisoned by pesticides every year, experts find
title.zh: 专家发现：近一半全球农民每年遭受农药中毒

summary.en: A study reveals that nearly half of the world's farmers experience pesticide poisoning annually, resulting in 11,000 deaths each year, with India bearing the brunt of nearly 60% of these fatalities. The research, based on data from 2006-2023, estimates 402-433 million cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning...

body.en: Study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people each year, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found. Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network , found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究显示，农药中毒每年导致 11,000 人死亡，其中印度占死亡人数的近 60%。一项研究发现，全球每年有近一半的农民因农药中毒。这项由农药行动网络委托进行的研究利用 2006 年至 2023 年的公开数据发现，每年估计有 4.02 亿至 4.33 亿农民和农场工人意外急性农药中毒病例。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study paints a grim picture of the daily reality for millions of farmers, who face severe health risks from the very tools they use to sustain us. Their plight often goes unnoticed, a silent crisis affecting those who feed the world. We are called to lend our voices to their cause, advocating for safer conditions and greater protection for these...
reflection.zh: 这项研究描绘了数百万农民日常现实的严峻景象，他们面临着使用以维持我们生计的工具所带来的严重健康风险。他们的困境常常被忽视，这是一场影响着养活世界的人们的无声危机。我们被呼召为他们的事业发声，倡导更安全的环境和为这些重要的劳动者提供更大的保护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.zh: 作者勘误：内源性大麻素通过逆行增益控制促进奖励参与

summary.en: This is an author correction for a previously published article titled 'Endocannabinoids facilitate reward engagement through retrograde gain control,' published online in Nature on September 2, 2026. The correction pertains to the scientific findings presented in the original paper.
summary.zh: 这是2026年9月2日在线发表在《自然》杂志上的文章“内源性大麻素通过逆行增益控制促进奖励参与”的作者勘误。该勘误涉及了原论文中呈现的科学发现。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, even when it requires correction, reflects a deep human drive to understand the intricate workings of the world around us. Job 12:7 reminds us that the natural world itself is a source of wisdom, teaching us about the Creator's design through its complex systems.
reflection.zh: 追求知识，即使需要勘误，也反映了人类深入了解周围世界复杂运作机制的深层驱动力。约伯记12:7提醒我们，自然世界本身就是智慧的源泉，通过其复杂的系统教导我们关于创造者的设计。

reflection.en: This retraction note from Nature highlights a challenge within the scientific pursuit of knowledge. As understanding expands, so too does the potential for error or misinterpretation, reminding us that the quest for truth is often iterative and requires careful scrutiny. The rapid increase in knowledge, as described in Daniel 12:4, is a hallmark of our age,...
reflection.zh: 《自然》杂志的这则撤稿启事，凸显了科学探求知识过程中面临的挑战。随着理解的深化，错误的或被误解的可能性也随之增加，这提醒我们追求真理的道路往往是反复的，需要仔细审视。但以理但以理书12:4所描述的知识的迅速增长是我们这个时代的标志，而这一事件则强调了勤奋研究和谦卑修正并存的必要性。

title.zh: 音频长篇阅读：修复受损DNA能延长寿命吗？

summary.en: Researchers are hunting for ways to enhance DNA repair with the hopes that this will keep people healthier for longer.
summary.zh: 研究人员正在寻找增强DNA修复的方法，希望以此能使人们更健康地活得更长久。

reflection.en: The pursuit of extending human health through DNA repair touches on profound questions about life's design. Psalm 139:14 reminds us that our very existence is a marvel, intricately woven by a Creator. This scientific endeavor, while seeking to mend and prolong, can also lead us to a deeper appreciation for the wonder of life itself.
reflection.zh: 通过DNA修复来延长人类健康的追求触及了关于生命设计的深刻问题。诗篇139:14提醒我们，我们自身的存在本身就是一件奇迹，是由一位创造者精心编织而成的。这项科学努力，在寻求修复和延长的同时，也能引导我们更深刻地欣赏生命本身的奇妙。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Functional chimeric mRNAs encode proteins in mammalian immunity
title.zh: 功能性嵌合mRNA编码哺乳动物免疫蛋白

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that inflammation can trigger interchromosomal DNA interactions, bringing parent genes closer together. This proximity facilitates the creation of chimeric mRNAs, which then encode functional proteins relevant to mammalian immunity.
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，炎症会触发染色体间的DNA相互作用，使亲本基因彼此靠近。这种近距离接触促进了嵌合mRNA的形成，进而编码与哺乳动物免疫相关的功能性蛋白质。

reflection.en: The intricate dance of DNA within our bodies, as described in this study, points to a profound wisdom embedded in creation. Even in the midst of inflammation, the body's systems can adapt and create new functional proteins, a testament to the complex and purposeful design we observe in nature.
reflection.zh: 本研究描述的我们体内DNA的复杂互动，指向了创造中蕴含的深刻智慧。即使在炎症之中，身体的系统也能适应并创造出新的功能性蛋白质，这证明了我们在自然界中观察到的复杂而有目的的设计。

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Watch: BBC travels in self-driving Uber around London
title.zh: 观看：BBC在伦敦的自动驾驶Uber中旅行

summary.en: The BBC's Zoe Kleinman takes a ride on Uber's self-driving robotaxi as the service rolls out on Thursday. Customers in London can now travel in the UK's first robotaxis as Uber launches its self-driving minicab on Thursday, becoming the first company to launch the service. Initially, it has 15 autonomous vehicles with...
summary.zh: BBC的佐伊·克莱因曼周四乘坐Uber的自动驾驶机器人出租车，该服务已在伦敦推出。伦敦的顾客现在可以乘坐英国首批机器人出租车，因为Uber于周四推出了其自动驾驶迷你出租车，成为首家推出此服务的公司。最初，该公司在伦敦只有15辆获得运营许可的自动驾驶汽车，每辆车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员。目前，机器人出租车的英国票价将...

body.en:
Customers in London can now travel in the UK's first robotaxis as Uber launches its self-driving minicab on Thursday - the company is the first to launch the service.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

At the moment, the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

The BBC's Zoe Kleinman was the first British journalist to hail a self-driving Uber in London - here's how the ride went.
body.zh: 优步周四推出了自动驾驶小型出租车，伦敦的顾客现在可以乘坐英国第一辆机器人出租车出行——该公司是第一家推出这项服务的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 BBC 的佐伊·克莱曼 (Zoe Kleinman) 是第一位在伦敦称赞自动驾驶 Uber 的英国记者 - 以下是乘坐过程。

reflection.en: The rollout of self-driving taxis in London marks a significant leap in technological advancement, bringing science fiction closer to reality. As Daniel prophesied, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This innovation promises convenience and efficiency, yet it also prompts reflection on how we integrate such powerful tools into our...
reflection.zh: 自动驾驶出租车在伦敦的推出标志着技术进步的重大飞跃，使科幻小说更接近现实。正如但以理所预言的，“许多人来往奔走，知识就必增长。”这项创新带来了便利和效率，但它也促使我们反思如何将如此强大的工具融入我们的生活和社会。
