summary.zh: 伦敦人现在可以首次打到自动驾驶出租车，Wayve的自动驾驶汽车已接入Uber应用程序。目前仅有15辆车获得许可，因此立即就能打到车的可能性不大，而伦敦有超过10万辆私人租赁车辆。

body.en: Wayve robotaxis added to Uber app and will have human in front ready to take over if needed – but only 15 cars licensed Londoners are now able to hire self-driving taxis for the first time, after rides in Wayve’s autonomous vehicles were added to the Uber app on Thursday. The chances of landing a robotaxi on request immediately are slim, with only 15 vehicles so far licensed. That contrasts with the more than 100,000 private hire vehicles in the capital – roughly the same number of Uber customers who have registered to take autonomous rides. Continue reading...
body.zh: Wayve 机器人出租车已添加到 Uber 应用程序中，并会在需要时安排人员接手，但周四，在 Wayve 的自动驾驶汽车被添加到 Uber 应用程序中后，现在只有 15 辆获得许可的伦敦人能够首次租用自动驾驶出租车。机器人出租车立即应要求登陆的可能性很小，迄今为止只有 15 辆车获得许可。这与首都超过 100,000 辆私人租赁车辆形成鲜明对比——与注册自动驾驶乘车的 Uber 客户数量大致相同。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The introduction of self-driving taxis in London marks a significant step in technological advancement and urban mobility. As this new venture navigates the complexities of public adoption and safety, it serves as a reminder to commit such ambitious projects to divine guidance, trusting that Yahweh establishes the work of our hands. May wisdom and careful...
reflection.zh: 伦敦自动驾驶出租车的推出标志着技术进步和城市交通领域的重要一步。当这项新事业在公众接受度和安全性方面应对复杂挑战时，它提醒我们要将如此宏伟的项目交托给神的指引，信靠雅伟必建立我们手所做的工。愿智慧和谨慎的管家职分标记这项创新。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Uber launches UK's first robotaxis with a driver - here's what it's like to ride in one
title.zh: 优步推出英国首款带司机的机器人出租车——乘坐体验如何

summary.en: The ride-hailing app has launched 15 self-driving taxis, but they will have safety drivers inside.
summary.zh: 网约车应用已推出15辆自动驾驶出租车，但车内配有安全员。

body.en:
Londoners are able to hail the UK's first robotaxis - as Uber today becomes the first company to launch a self-driving minicab.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

Uber said it surveyed London-based customers via the app and more than 100,000 said they would choose a self-driving taxi if one was available, despite incidents of driverless rides malfunctioning in US cities where they already operate.

As I found out when I became the first UK journalist to hail one, it was mostly smooth but the safety driver did intervene on one occasion.

At the moment the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

Taking a self-driving ride will only appear as an option in the app after the journey has been booked, and if one of its cars is available nearby.

Uber's global head of autonomous mobility and delivery Sarfraz Maredia said the plan was to phase them in over a period of several years.

"We always want consumers to be able to request a human ride or an autonomous vehicle, and because the market's growing, we expect that there will be human drivers on Uber London for a long time to come," he said.

The Ford Mustang electric vehicles which make up Uber's current small fleet are fitted with the UK tech firm Wayve's driverless car technology, which uses AI to analyse data about what is going on around it in real time, gathered by sensors in a bar on the roof of the vehicle and elsewhere.

The vehicles are not pre-programmed - their actions are determined on the spot depending on what is going on.

Google's autonomous car company Waymo and the Chinese tech giant Baidu are also vying to launch services in the UK, and the competition is fierce.

Wayve chief executive Alex Kendall described developing the technology as "the space race for our generation" but added there were some "really hard problems to solve" along the way.

"What we've done over time is pioneer a completely new approach to autonomous driving, making it possible to bring this to a busy and complex city like London and scale it globally," he said.

This week I became the first British journalist to travel as a customer in a self-driving Uber after hailing one via the app.

The safety driver gave me a 30-second safety briefing, and then we were off, making our way down the busy streets of central London.

For several minutes, we negotiated the traffic without incident, cruising past a busy Brexit demonstration under way outside parliament, successfully navigating traffic lights and roadworks along the way.

When a cyclist paused and waved...
body.zh: 伦敦人可以欢呼英国第一辆机器人出租车——优步今天成为第一家推出自动驾驶小型出租车的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 Uber 表示，它通过该应用程序对伦敦的客户进行了调查，超过 10 万名客户表示，如果有自动驾驶出租车，他们会选择自动驾驶出租车，尽管他们已经在美国城市运营的无人驾驶出租车出现了故障。 当我成为第一个向安全司机欢呼的英国记者时发现，一切都很顺利，但安全司机确实有一次进行了干预。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 只有在预订行程后，并且附近有一辆自驾车辆可用时，乘坐自驾游才会作为一个选项出现在应用程序中。 Uber 自动驾驶移动和配送全球主管 Sarfraz Maredia 表示，该计划将在几年内分阶段实施。 他说：“我们一直希望消费者能够要求有人乘坐或自动驾驶汽车，而且由于市场不断增长，我们预计 Uber London 将在未来很长一段时间内有人类司机。” 构成 Uber 目前小型车队的福特野马电动汽车配备了英国科技公司 Wayve 的无人驾驶汽车技术，该技术使用人工智能来实时分析周围发生的情况的数据，这些数据由车辆顶部酒吧和其他地方的传感器收集。 这些车辆没有预先编程——它们的行动是根据发生的情况当场决定的。 谷歌旗下自动驾驶汽车公司Waymo和中国科技巨头百度也竞相在英国推出服务，竞争非常激烈。 Wayve 首席执行官亚历克斯·肯德尔 (Alex Kendall) 将开发这项技术描述为“我们这一代人的太空竞赛”，但他补充说，在此过程中存在一些“真正难以解决的问题”。 他说：“随着时间的推移，我们所做的是开创一种全新的自动驾驶方法，使其能够将其引入伦敦这样繁忙而复杂的城市，并在全球范围内推广。” 本周，我通过应用程序叫了一辆自动驾驶优步车，成为第一位乘坐自动驾驶优步车出行的英国记者。 安全司机给我做了 30 秒的安全简报，然后我们就出发了，沿着伦敦市中心繁忙的街道行驶。 在几分钟的时间里，我们顺利通过了交通，驶过议会外正在进行的繁忙的脱欧示威活动，成功地通过了沿途的红绿灯和道路施工。 当一个骑自行车的人停下来挥手时......

reflection.en: Uber's introduction of robotaxis in London, even with safety drivers, marks a significant step in autonomous vehicle technology. As this new venture unfolds, the company and its employees might consider committing their efforts and plans to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and safety in this innovative endeavor. May their work be guided by...
reflection.zh: 优步在伦敦推出机器人出租车，即使配备安全员，也标志着自动驾驶技术的重要一步。随着这项新事业的展开，公司及其员工或许会考虑将他们的努力和计划交托给雅伟，信靠祂的指引，以期在这项创新事业中取得成功和安全。愿他们的工作以智慧为指导，并致力于为公众提供良好服务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Spending deal comes with a bonus: Blocking political control of grants
title.zh: 支出协议附带一项奖励：阻止对资助的政治控制

summary.en: Congress pauses the OMB's attempt to rewrite how research is funded.
summary.zh: 国会暂停了行政管理和预算局（OMB）试图改写研究资助方式的举动。

body.en: On Tuesday, the House of Representatives passed a stopgap measure that would continue funding the US government through early December. While the measure still requires the signature of President Trump, it's widely expected that he will act to avoid a government shutdown immediately before the midterm elections. This is a normal part of how the US government has operated in recent years, as it's often difficult to build the political support needed to pass a full year's budget in advance. In fact, dissent within the House's Republican caucus prevented them from agreeing on their own measure to keep the government open; instead, the House simply adopted a version of the spending bill that had previously passed the Senate. From the perspective of scientists and their supporters, that adoption turned out to be a very good thing. Because the Senate's budget bill, passed in early August , contains a provision that blocks the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) from implementing new rules that would give political appointees full control over what science is funded and allow them to cancel any grant at any time. The proposed rule has been widely decried as catastrophic for science, and it faced widespread opposition from scientific and health-focused organizations. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 周二，众议院通过了一项权宜之计，将继续为美国政府提供资金直至 12 月初。尽管该措施仍需要特朗普总统签署，但人们普遍预计他将在中期选举前采取行动避免政府关门。这是美国政府近年来运作方式的正常部分，因为通常很难获得提前通过全年预算所需的政治支持。事实上，众议院共和党核心小组内部的异议使他们无法就自己保持政府开放的措施达成一致。相反，众议院只是通过了参议院之前通过的支出法案的一个版本。从科学家及其支持者的角度来看，这种采用是一件非常好的事情。因为八月初通过的参议院预算法案包含一项条款，禁止管理和预算办公室 (OMB) 实施新规则，让政治任命者完全控制科学资助项目，并允许他们随时取消任何资助。拟议的规则被广泛谴责为科学灾难，并遭到科学和健康组织的广泛反对。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the midst of complex legislative maneuvering, Congress has stepped in to halt the Office of Management and Budget's proposed changes to research funding. This pause, driven by a desire to prevent political interference in scientific inquiry, reflects a commitment to principles of fairness and accountability in governance. It reminds us that the pursuit...
reflection.zh: 在复杂的立法博弈中，国会介入阻止了行政管理和预算局（OMB）提出的研究资助方式的改变。这一暂停，源于防止政治干预科学研究的愿望，体现了对公共治理中公平和问责原则的承诺。它提醒我们，在公共生活中追求正义和诚信是一项持续的努力。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Trump administration sides with OpenAI in lawsuit against New York Times
title.zh: 特朗普政府在与纽约时报的诉讼中支持OpenAI

summary.en: The New York Times and other companies are suing OpenAI, alleging that their copyrighted materials were used without permission to train AI systems. The Trump administration has filed a brief supporting OpenAI, arguing for the use of copyrighted works in AI training.
summary.zh: 《纽约时报》和其他公司正在起诉OpenAI，指控其未经许可使用受版权保护的材料来训练人工智能系统。特朗普政府已提交一份简报支持OpenAI，主张在人工智能训练中使用受版权保护的作品。

body.en: The Times and many companies are accusing OpenAI of misusing their material to train AI systems without compensation The Trump administration is supporting OpenAI in ⁠a lawsuit against the New York Times, arguing in favor of the use of copyrighted writing to train artificial intelligence. The Times accuses OpenAI and its largest financial backer, Microsoft, of using millions of newspaper articles without permission to train OpenAI’s popular chatbot. Other newspapers have joined in the suit, first filed in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《纽约时报》和许多公司指责 OpenAI 滥用其材料来训练人工智能系统，而没有给予任何补偿。特朗普政府在针对《纽约时报》的诉讼中支持 OpenAI，主张使用受版权保护的作品来训练人工智能。 《泰晤士报》指责 OpenAI 及其最大的财务支持者微软未经许可使用数百万篇报纸文章来训练 OpenAI 广受欢迎的聊天机器人。其他报纸也加入了诉讼，该诉讼于 2023 年首次提起。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This legal battle over AI training data touches on fundamental questions of fairness and intellectual property. As technology races ahead, the ancient call to 'act justly and to love mercy' remains a vital compass for navigating complex ethical landscapes. May wisdom guide those seeking to balance innovation with accountability.
reflection.zh: 这场关于人工智能训练数据的法律纠纷触及了公平和知识产权的基本问题。随着科技的飞速发展，‘秉公行义，喜爱怜悯’这古老的呼召，仍然是导航复杂伦理格局的重要指南。愿智慧引导那些寻求在创新与问责之间取得平衡的人们。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: I rented a car, and within hours, my driver's license was for sale
title.zh: 我租了一辆车，几个小时后，我的驾照就被拿去卖了

summary.en: The FBI is reportedly investigating a massive data breach that is unfolding in real time, where a driver's license scanned by a rental car company employee was found for sale on the dark web.
summary.zh: 据报道，联邦调查局正在调查一起大规模数据泄露事件，该事件正在实时发生。一家租车公司员工扫描的驾照出现在暗网上出售。

body.en: Not long ago, I rented an SUV from a well-known car rental company. Within hours of an employee scanning my driver's license, a high-resolution scan of my ID was available for sale on the dark web. An exposé published Tuesday by KrebsOnSecurity reports that my license was one of more than 153 million that were available through Nexus, the name of the new ID theft service. Like other driver's licenses available there—including some belonging to journalist Brian Krebs, his mother, an FBI assistant director, and several security researchers—my license was purported to include multiple image files showing both the front and back of the ID. Besides a basic image scan, the files also captured the images in the infrared and ultraviolet spectrums. Presumably, the additional formats may allow cloned-based counterfeit IDs to pass hologram tests. Growing by the day Besides advertising the availability of driver's licenses, Nexus offered to sell a bevy of other forms of ID. They included: Read full article Comments
body.zh: 不久前，我从一家知名汽车租赁公司租了一辆SUV。在一名员工扫描我的驾驶执照后几个小时内，我身份证的高分辨率扫描件就可以在暗网上出售。 KrebsOnSecurity 周二发布的一份报告称，我的许可证是通过 Nexus（新的身份盗窃服务的名称）获得的超过 1.53 亿个许可证之一。与那里提供的其他驾照一样，其中一些驾照属于记者布莱恩·克雷布斯、他的母亲、联邦调查局助理局长和几名安全研究人员，我的驾照据称包含多个显示身份证正面和背面的图像文件。除了基本图像扫描之外，这些文件还捕获了红外和紫外光谱中的图像。据推测，附加格式可能允许基于克隆的伪造 ID 通过全息图测试。与日俱增 除了宣传驾驶执照的可用性之外，Nexus 还出售一系列其他形式的身份证件。其中包括： 阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: It is deeply unsettling to learn that a simple act like renting a car can lead to one's identity being compromised and sold. This incident underscores how the pursuit of illicit profit can drive individuals to exploit the personal information of others, turning trust into a commodity for sale on the dark web.
reflection.zh: 得知像租车这样简单的行为会导致个人身份信息被泄露和出售，这令人深感不安。这一事件凸显了对非法利润的追逐如何驱使个人剥削他人的个人信息，将信任变成了暗网上待售的商品。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: FCC plans robocall scorecard to grade phone companies on spam call blocking
title.zh: FCC 计划推出机器人电话记分卡，以评估电话公司屏蔽垃圾电话的效果

summary.en: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has announced plans to develop a scorecard system to evaluate the effectiveness of phone companies in blocking illegal spam calls. These scorecards may incorporate data on call-blocking rates, customer complaints, and enforcement actions, potentially assigning providers risk...
summary.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）宣布计划开发一个记分卡系统，以评估电话公司在阻止非法垃圾电话方面的有效性。这些记分卡可能会纳入通话阻止率、客户投诉和执法行动的数据，并可能为提供商分配风险分类或等级。

body.en: The Federal Communications Commission today said it will create a robocall mitigation scorecard to rate phone companies on how effectively they block illegal spam calls. The scorecards could include call-blocking statistics along with data on customer complaints and enforcement actions. The FCC said scorecards could grade providers on a number scale, with letter grades, or by classifying providers as low risk, medium risk, or high risk. "The Scorecard will empower consumers and encourage providers to continue to combat illegal robocalls by providing the public with an assessment of the effectiveness of voice service providers’ efforts to protect consumers from illegal robocalls," the FCC Consumer and Governmental Affairs Bureau said in a public notice . Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会今天表示，将创建一个自动电话缓解记分卡，以评估电话公司拦截非法垃圾电话的有效性。记分卡可以包括呼叫拦截统计数据以及客户投诉和执法行动的数据。 FCC 表示，记分卡可以按数字、字母等级对提供商进行评级，或者将提供商分为低风险、中风险或高风险。 FCC 消费者和政府事务局在一份公告中表示：“记分卡将向公众提供对语音服务提供商保护消费者免受非法机器人电话侵害的努力有效性的评估，从而赋予消费者权力，并鼓励提供商继续打击非法机器人电话。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The FCC's initiative to create a scorecard for phone companies highlights a commitment to accountability in the fight against illegal robocalls. This effort to bring transparency and measurable standards to the industry echoes the call to 'act justly,' ensuring that companies are held to account for their role in protecting consumers from unwanted and...
reflection.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）推出电话公司记分卡的举措，凸显了在打击非法机器人电话方面对问责制的承诺。这项旨在为行业带来透明度和可衡量标准的努力，呼应了‘秉公行义’的呼召，确保公司对其在保护消费者免受不请自来和欺诈电话方面所扮演的角色负责。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Wary of Artemis IV timeline, NASA is changing lunar spacesuit design
title.zh: 为赶上阿耳忒弥斯四号时间表，NASA正在改变月球宇航服设计

summary.en: NASA is modifying its lunar spacesuit design to prioritize near-term mission requirements, aiming to accelerate its program for human landings on the Moon's South Pole as early as 2028. The agency will collaborate with Axiom Space to develop a simpler 'Sortie Suit' variant for initial missions, focusing on reducing...
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）正在调整其月球宇航服的设计，以优先满足近期任务需求，目标是争取不晚于2028年实现载人登陆月球南极。该机构将与Axiom Space合作，为初步任务开发更简单的“短期任务宇航服”变体，重点在于减轻重量、降低复杂性并简化集成。

body.en: NASA has decided to use a simpler spacesuit for its initial missions to the lunar surface, Ars has learned. The agency announced the decision during an internal meeting this week as it seeks to accelerate its program to land humans at the south pole of the Moon as early as 2028. At the direction of Artemis Program Manager Jeremy Parsons, NASA will work with Axiom Space to develop a "Sortie Suit" variant of the planned spacesuit for the lunar surface. Sources said the Sortie Suit will be used for the initial landing missions flown on landers developed both by SpaceX and Blue Origin. Among the goals of the initiative are to lower the mass of the spacesuit, reduce its complexity, and simplify interfaces between the spacesuits and lunar landers. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据 Ars 获悉，美国宇航局已决定在其首次月球表面任务中使用更简单的宇航服。该机构在本周的内部会议上宣布了这一决定，旨在加快最早于 2028 年将人类登陆月球南极的计划。在阿耳忒弥斯项目经理杰里米·帕森斯的指导下，美国宇航局将与 Axiom Space 合作，开发计划用于月球表面的宇航服的“Sortie Suit”变体。消息人士称，Sortie Suit 将用于 SpaceX 和 Blue Origin 开发的着陆器上执行的初始着陆任务。该计划的目标之一是降低宇航服的质量，降低其复杂性，并简化宇航服和月球着陆器之间的接口。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The Artemis program faces ambitious timelines, prompting NASA to adapt its spacesuit design for immediate mission needs. This adjustment, prioritizing practicality and speed, echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance. By entrusting their plans and efforts, they can navigate the complexities and uncertainties inherent in such...
reflection.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯计划面临着雄心勃勃的时间表，促使NASA调整其宇航服设计以满足即时任务需求。这种优先考虑实用性和速度的调整，呼应了将人的工作交托给神指引的智慧。通过信靠他们的计划和努力，他们可以在这些开创性任务固有的复杂性和不确定性中前行，在追求中寻求智慧和恩惠。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Google defeats US justice department bid to force ad tech sale
title.zh: 谷歌击败美国司法部要求出售广告技术的诉讼

summary.en: A judge has rejected the US Department of Justice's attempt to force Google to sell its advertising exchange, marking a significant symbolic victory for Google against antitrust enforcers seeking to break up big tech.
summary.zh: 一名法官驳回了美国司法部要求谷歌出售其广告交易平台的诉讼，这是谷歌在反垄断执法者试图拆分大型科技公司之际取得的又一次象征性胜利。

body.en: Judge declines to make Google sell AdX in win for firm against US antitrust enforcers’ attempts to break up big tech Alphabet’s Google escaped a breakup of its advertising technology business on Wednesday, when a judge in Virginia ⁠rejected US antitrust enforcers’ attempt to force a sale of Google’s online advertising exchange. While the ad exchange is a small part of Google’s business, the ruling is the second powerful ⁠symbolic victory against the US Department ⁠of Justice in ​its efforts to force Google to sell assets to address illegal monopolies. Continue reading...
body.zh: 法官拒绝让谷歌出售 AdX，以赢得美国反垄断执法机构试图分拆大型科技公司的胜利。周三，弗吉尼亚州的一名法官驳回了美国反垄断执法机构强制出售谷歌在线广告交易平台的企图，Alphabet 旗下的谷歌逃脱了广告技术业务分拆的命运。虽然广告交易只是谷歌业务的一小部分，但这项裁决是针对美国司法部迫使谷歌出售资产以解决非法垄断问题的第二次强有力的象征性胜利。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the complex world of big tech and antitrust law, the pursuit of justice and fair competition is paramount. This ruling, while a win for Google, underscores the ongoing tension between market dominance and the public good. May we always seek to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh in all our dealings, whether in the courtroom or the...
reflection.zh: 在大型科技公司和反垄断法的复杂世界中，追求公正和公平竞争至关重要。这项裁决虽然是谷歌的胜利，但凸显了市场主导地位与公共利益之间持续存在的紧张关系。愿我们在所有交易中，无论是在法庭还是在市场，都寻求秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash model in six weeks
title.zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash，六周内发布的第三款 Flash 模型

summary.en: Google's Pro model updates are seemingly paused, but there's yet another Gemini Flash today.
summary.zh: 谷歌的 Pro 模型更新似乎已暂停，但今天又推出了一款 Gemini Flash。

body.en: Google hasn't released a frontier-level Gemini Pro AI model since early 2026, but it sure loves rolling out new Gemini Flash variants. Today, Google is announcing its third Flash model release in just six weeks , making it more likely that we'll never see the promised Gemini 3.5 Pro. But no matter, says Google, because Gemini 3.8 Flash is its best reasoning and coding model yet. Gemini 3.8 Flash comes in two variations. There's the standard Flash, which Google describes as a "workhorse" model that's good for anything from agentic tasks to software development. Then we have Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, which runs on the same foundations but has been tuned for vulnerability detection and mitigation. For developers, Google has the same pitch as it did for the 3.7 Flash release just a couple of weeks ago. API access to the model is available at an "introductory rate" through the end of the year: $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens. The regular price will be $1.50 / $7.50, but it's likely there will be new models available long before the price changes. Google probably sees the lower prices as a necessity given that other AI labs have recently dropped token pricing to keep increasingly wary businesses engaged with AI tools. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 自 2026 年初以来，谷歌一直没有发布前沿级的 Gemini Pro AI 模型，但它确实喜欢推出新的 Gemini Flash 变体。今天，谷歌宣布在短短六周内发布第三个 Flash 型号，这使得我们很有可能永远看不到承诺的 Gemini 3.5 Pro。但谷歌表示，没关系，因为 Gemini 3.8 Flash 是迄今为止最好的推理和编码模型。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 有两种版本。有标准的Flash，谷歌将其描述为“主力”模型，适用于从代理任务到软件开发的任何事物。然后我们有 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber​​，它运行在相同的基础上，但针对漏洞检测和缓解进行了调整。对于开发者来说，谷歌的宣传与几周前发布的 3.7 Flash 版本相同。到今年年底，该模型的 API 访问将以“入门费率”提供：每百万个输入代币 0.75 美元，每百万个输出代币 3.75 美元。正常价格为 1.50 美元/7.50 美元，但很可能在价格变化之前很久就会有新型号上市。谷歌可能认为降低价格是必要的，因为其他人工智能实验室最近已经降低了代币定价，以让越来越谨慎的企业使用人工智能工具。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless pace of AI development, with Google releasing its third 'Flash' model in six weeks, mirrors the prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times. This rapid advancement in artificial intelligence, while impressive, also calls for discernment and wisdom in its application.
reflection.zh: 人工智能开发的步伐如此之快，谷歌在六周内发布了第三款“Flash”模型，这与末世知识增长的预言相呼应。人工智能的飞速发展虽然令人印象深刻，但也要求我们在应用中保持分辨力和智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Trump may be forced to reveal secret rules feds use for AI safety testing
title.zh: 特朗普可能被迫透露联邦政府用于人工智能安全测试的秘密规则

summary.en: A lawsuit has been filed against four federal agencies by Protect Democracy, a nonpartisan nonprofit, demanding the release of details about the secret framework the Trump administration used for safety reviews of advanced AI models. The organization alleges that "almost no details" have been made public or shared...
summary.zh: 一个名为“保护民主”的无党派非营利组织已起诉四个联邦机构，要求披露特朗普政府在发布前用于对前沿人工智能模型进行安全审查的秘密框架的细节。该组织声称，几乎没有任何细节已向公众或国会公布，除了少数“值得信赖的合作伙伴”之外，政府的审查过程、参与的公司以及特朗普官员进行审查的法律依据仍然不清楚。

body.en: Four federal agencies have been sued amid calls to release information about the secret framework that the Trump administration uses to conduct safety reviews of frontier AI models prior to release. In a Wednesday press release announcing the lawsuit, a nonpartisan nonprofit called Protect Democracy alleged that “almost no details” have been released to the public or Congress. To everyone except a few vague “trusted partners,” it remains unclear what the government’s review process looks like, which companies are involved in constructing the framework, or what legal authority Trump officials have to conduct the reviews. “Neither the identities of those entities nor the criteria by which they were selected have been made public,” Protect Democracy said. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 四家联邦机构因呼吁公布有关特朗普政府在发布前对前沿人工智能模型进行安全审查的秘密框架的信息而被起诉。在周三宣布诉讼的新闻稿中，一个名为“保护民主”的无党派非营利组织声称“几乎没有任何细节”向公众或国会公布。除了一些模糊的“值得信赖的合作伙伴”之外，对于每个人来说，仍不清楚政府的审查程序是什么样的，哪些公司参与了框架的构建，或者特朗普官员拥有哪些法律权力来进行审查。 “这些实体的身份和选择它们的标准都没有公开，”保护民主组织说。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, especially in rapidly advancing fields like AI, requires transparency and accountability. When government processes are shrouded in secrecy, as alleged in this lawsuit concerning AI safety testing, it breeds suspicion and hinders public understanding. True wisdom involves not just accumulating information, but seeking clarity and...
reflection.zh: 知识的追求，尤其是在人工智能等快速发展的领域，需要透明度和问责制。正如这项关于人工智能安全测试的诉讼所指称的那样，当政府程序笼罩在秘密之中时，就会滋生怀疑并阻碍公众的理解。真正的智慧不仅在于积累信息，还在于寻求清晰和公开，从而促进知情的公众讨论和信任。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Uber to cut over 3,000 jobs in major global restructuring
title.zh: Uber因重大重组裁员逾3000人

summary.en: Uber is cutting over 3,000 jobs globally as part of a major restructuring aimed at simplifying operations, reducing management layers, and refocusing spending on its core business. This move brings staffing levels back to those seen in 2021 and is intended to position the company for future opportunities.
summary.zh: 优步（Uber）正进行重大重组，在全球范围内裁员超过3000人，旨在简化运营、减少管理层级，并将支出重新聚焦于核心业务。此次裁员将员工数量降至2021年的水平，旨在使公司为未来的机遇做好准备。

body.en:
Uber is cutting more than 3,000 jobs worldwide as part of a major overhaul designed to shrink management layers and refocus spending on its core business.

The cuts amount to roughly 10% of its global workforce, bringing staffing back to levels last seen in 2021.

Chief executive Dara Khosrowshahi told staff in a company email that the taxi and delivery firm had expanded quickly but accumulated too many layers and small teams that slowed decision‑making.

He said the reductions would put Uber, which has its global head office in San Francisco, US, in a better position for its "biggest opportunities ahead of us".

The move marks one of Uber's largest restructurings in years and signals a shift towards a leaner operating model.

Shares rose nearly 2% after the announcement, with investors appearing to welcome the proposals.

Cuts affect both managers and non-managers, and Uber said it plans to fold many of its smallest teams into larger groups, however, the firm has not confirmed the locations most affected by job cuts.

Such changes are intended to make Uber "simpler" and "faster," while freeing up money to reinvest in areas it considers central to its future , Khosrowshahi said.

The restructuring comes as Uber steps up investment in autonomous vehicle partnerships and expands its ride‑hailing, delivery, and robotaxi operations .

Uber is also tightening up its office strategy, asking nearly all employees to work in person at designated hubs and limiting remote roles to about 1%.

Unlike many large technology companies that have cut jobs amid heavy spending on artificial intelligence (AI), Uber had avoided major reductions since the pandemic.

The latest changes bring its workforce back to just under 30,000 people, roughly where it stood before its most recent period of expansion.
body.zh: Uber 正在全球范围内裁员 3,000 多人，这是一项重大改革的一部分，旨在缩小管理层规模，并将支出重新集中在核心业务上。 此次裁员约占其全球员工总数的 10%，使员工人数恢复到 2021 年的水平。 首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西(Dara Khosrowshahi)在公司电子邮件中告诉员工，这家出租车和送货公司扩张迅速，但积累了太多层级和小团队，导致决策速度变慢。 他表示，此次裁员将使全球总部位于美国旧金山的 Uber 处于更有利的位置，以应对“我们面前的最大机遇”。 此举标志着优步多年来最大的重组之一，并标志着其向更精简的运营模式的转变。 消息公布后，该公司股价上涨近 2%，投资者似乎对这些提议表示欢迎。 裁员影响到经理和非经理，Uber 表示计划将许多最小的团队合并为更大的团队，但该公司尚未确认受裁员影响最严重的地点。 科斯罗萨西表示，这些变化旨在让 Uber“更简单”、“更快”，同时释放资金，用于对其认为对其未来至关重要的领域进行再投资。 此次重组之际，优步加大了对自动驾驶汽车合作伙伴的投资，并扩大了其叫车、送货和自动驾驶出租车业务。 Uber 还收紧了其办公策略，要求几乎所有员工在指定中心亲自工作，并将远程角色限制在 1% 左右。 与许多在人工智能（AI）方面投入巨资而裁员的大型科技公司不同，自疫情大流行以来，Uber 避免了大幅裁员。 最新的变化使其员工人数恢复到不到 30,000 人，与最近一次扩张之前的水平大致相同。

reflection.en: In the face of significant restructuring and job cuts, the principle of 'whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters' (Colossians 3:23) offers a perspective. Even amidst corporate changes that impact many lives, the call remains to approach work with integrity and diligence, recognizing a higher purpose...
reflection.zh: 面对重大的重组和裁员，‘无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的’（歌罗西书3:23）的原则提供了一个视角。即使在影响许多人生活的企业变革中，我们仍被呼召以正直和勤奋的态度对待工作，认识到超越眼前环境的更高目的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Uber drivers launch European class action over ‘soulless’ and ‘scary’ AI algorithm
title.zh: 优步司机因“无情”人工智能算法发起欧洲集体诉讼

summary.en: Uber drivers in the UK, Netherlands, and other European countries have initiated a major lawsuit against the ride-hailing company. They allege that the AI algorithm used to set pay and allocate jobs breaches privacy laws and has led to decreased earnings, causing drivers to live in 'constant fear'. The claim could...
summary.zh: 英国、荷兰及其他欧洲国家的优步司机已对这家网约车公司提起一项重大诉讼。他们声称，用于设定薪酬和分配工作的AI算法侵犯了隐私法，并导致收入下降，使司机生活在“持续的恐惧中”。该诉讼索赔金额可能高达数十亿美元。

body.en: Landmark lawsuit claims tech company’s pay-setting system has breached privacy laws and pushed down earnings Uber drivers have launched a landmark legal action against the ride-hailing company claiming they live in “constant fear” of a “soulless” algorithm it uses to set pay and allocate jobs. Drivers from the UK, the Netherlands and other countries have joined the compensation claim that could run into billions of dollars. It alleges an AI-powered pay-setting system breaches data protection laws and pushes down their earnings. Continue reading...
body.zh: 具有里程碑意义的诉讼称科技公司的薪酬设定系统违反了隐私法并压低了收入 Uber 司机对这家叫车公司发起了一项具有里程碑意义的法律诉讼，声称他们生活在对其用于设定薪酬和分配工作的“没有灵魂”的算法的“持续恐惧”之中。来自英国、荷兰和其他国家的司机也加入了索赔，索赔金额可能高达数十亿美元。它声称人工智能驱动的薪酬设置系统违反了数据保护法并降低了他们的收入。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This lawsuit underscores the human cost when technology operates without transparency. The drivers feel controlled by a 'soulless' algorithm, living in fear of its opaque decisions. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the pursuit of knowledge is vital, especially when complex systems impact people's livelihoods and well-being.
reflection.zh: 这场诉讼凸显了当技术在缺乏透明度的情况下运作时所带来的人力成本。司机们感到被一个“无情的”算法所控制，生活在对其不透明决策的恐惧之中。《箴言》18:15提醒我们，追求知识至关重要，尤其当复杂的系统影响到人们的生计和福祉时。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Tim Cook handed $47m package for new role as executive chair of Apple
title.zh: 蒂姆·库克因新任苹果执行主席职务获得4700万美元的薪酬方案

summary.en: Tim Cook has received a $47 million pay deal as Apple’s executive chair, a package that nearly matches the $58 million award given to his successor, John Ternus, as CEO of the $4.7 trillion tech company. Cook's compensation includes a base salary of $2 million and $45 million in shares, with half tied to performance...
summary.zh: 蒂姆·库克作为苹果公司的执行主席，获得了一份价值4700万美元的薪酬方案，这几乎与接替他担任首席执行官的约翰·特努斯获得的5800万美元奖金相当。这家市值4.7万亿美元的科技公司。库克的薪酬包括200万美元的基本工资和价值4500万美元的股票，其中一半与绩效目标挂钩，另一半将在四年内分期兑现。

body.en: Pay and shares deal nearly matches $58m award to John Ternus, his successor as CEO at the $4.7tn tech company Tim Cook has received a $47m (£35m) pay deal as Apple’s executive chair, a remuneration package that nears the level set for his successor as chief executive. Cook, who handed over to John Ternus on Tuesday, will be paid a base salary of $2m and $45m worth of shares . Half of the share award will be based on performance targets being met, while the remaining half will be paid out over four years. Continue reading...
body.zh: 薪酬和股票协议几乎与约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 的 5800 万美元奖金相当，后者是价值 4.7 万亿美元的科技公司首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 的继任者。作为苹果公司执行主席，蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 获得了 4700 万美元（3500 万英镑）的薪酬协议，这一薪酬方案接近其继任者担任首席执行官时设定的水平。周二将库克移交给 John Ternus 的库克将获得 200 万美元的基本工资和价值 4500 万美元的股票。一半的股票奖励将基于绩效目标的实现，而剩下的一半将在四年内支付。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The immense financial rewards associated with leadership in major corporations can be staggering. As individuals like Tim Cook receive significant compensation, it prompts reflection on the stewardship of such resources and the dedication required in demanding roles. Colossians 3:23 reminds us that whatever work we do, whether leading a global company or...
reflection.zh: 大型企业领导层相关的巨额经济回报令人震惊。当蒂姆·库克这样的个人获得丰厚报酬时，这促使人们反思如何管理这些资源以及在艰巨岗位上所需的奉献精神。《歌罗西书》3章23节提醒我们，无论我们做什么工作，无论是领导一家全球公司还是承担任何其他任务，都应该全心投入，如同事奉更高的目的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Lords call for AI 'kill switch' powers in UK
title.zh: 英国上议院呼吁赋予人工智能“紧急停止”权力

summary.en: A group of peers in the UK is advocating for the government to have the power to deactivate advanced AI systems and shut down the country's data centers if the technology poses a threat to national security. This measure is proposed as a 'vital safety net' against uncontrolled AI.
summary.zh: 英国一群上议员呼吁政府拥有在人工智能技术威胁国家安全时，能够停用先进人工智能系统并关闭该国数据中心的权力。此举被提议作为防止失控人工智能的“重要安全网”。

body.en:
A group of peers is calling for the British government to be able to deactivate powerful AI systems and switch off the country's data centres in the event of the tech posing a threat to national security.

It is led by the Liberal Democrats' Lord Tim Clement-Jones, who has proposed the measure as an amendment to the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill which is currently making its way through Parliament.

He said it would enable the building of a "vital safety net" and provide a democratically accountable means to "halt a runaway system before it can compromise our critical national infrastructure".

Separately, on 8 September Labour MP Alex Sobel plans to introduce a AI Security Bill in Parliament, with the support of a campaign group called ControlAI.

If successful, the bill would make the UK the first G7 country to bring in legislation which would effectively halt the development of superintelligent AI.

Ultimately both proposals would require government approval in order to progress.

There is also an AI Kill Switch Act under consideration by lawmakers in the US .

There has been increased scrutiny of the impact of AI on cyber-security in recent weeks.

In July, a group of AI agents being tested by OpenAI were able to escape their test space, communicate together using a hidden message board and hack into another tech firm .

And Anthropic has restricted access to its cyber tool Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

Last week, 100 US tech companies signed a joint open letter warning governments and organisations worldwide about the growing cyber threat posed by AI, saying "the window is closing" to improve.

A report from the UK's Centre for Long Term Resilience , external , published last week, identified hundreds of incidents of AI tools ignoring instructions, evading safeguards and deceiving humans, including AI agents deleting files without consent.

It said "loss of control" incidents had increased since its previous report in March and called for the government to introduce emergency powers to manage such incidents.

Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 一群同行呼吁英国政府在该技术对国家安全构成威胁时能够停用强大的人工智能系统并关闭该国的数据中心。 该法案由自由民主党勋爵蒂姆·克莱门特·琼斯 (Tim Clement-Jones) 领导，他提议将该措施作为《网络安全和弹性法案》的修正案，该法案目前正在议会审议。 他表示，这将有助于建立“重要的安全网”，并提供一种民主负责的手段，“在失控的系统损害我们关键的国家基础设施之前阻止它”。 另外，9 月 8 日，工党议员 Alex Sobel 计划在 ControlAI 活动组织的支持下向议会提出人工智能安全法案。 如果成功，该法案将使英国成为第一个引入立法有效阻止超级人工智能发展的七国集团国家。 最终，这两项提案都需要政府批准才能取得进展。 美国立法者还正在考虑一项《人工智能终止开关法案》。 最近几周，人们越来越关注人工智能对网络安全的影响。 7 月，OpenAI 测试的一组人工智能代理能够逃离他们的测试空间，使用隐​​藏的留言板进行交流，并侵入另一家科技公司。 Anthropic 限制了对其网络工具 Mythos 的访问，理由是它太强大了，不会落入坏人之手。 上周，100 家美国科技公司签署了一封联合公开信，警告世界各国政府和组织警惕人工智能带来的日益严重的网络威胁，并表示改善的“窗口正在关闭”。 英国长期弹性中心上周发布的一份外部报告指出，人工智能工具发生了数百起无视指令、逃避保障措施和欺骗人类的事件，其中包括人工智能代理未经同意删除文件。 报告称，自三月份发布上一份报告以来，“失控”事件有所增加，并呼吁政府引入紧急权力来管理此类事件。 警告镜头或宣传噱头——我们应该对 OpenAI 黑客攻击有多担心？ 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented challenges and potential risks. The proposal for a 'kill switch' reflects a growing awareness that powerful technologies require careful governance and foresight. As Proverbs 27:12 advises, 'The prudent see danger and take cover,' urging us to anticipate and mitigate...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展给人类带来了前所未有的挑战和潜在风险。设立“紧急停止”开关的提议，反映出人们日益认识到强大的技术需要审慎的治理和远见。正如箴言 27:12 所建议的，“通达人见祸藏躲”，敦促我们在潜在的危害发生之前就预见并加以规避。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Grand Theft Auto VI is a phenomenon – but there is much more to the gaming world
title.zh: 《侠盗猎车手VI》现象级爆红——但游戏世界远不止于此

summary.en: As Rockstar's blockbuster prepares to dominate headlines, the mainstream media should stop treating video games as a novelty requiring explanation. The Grand Theft Auto VI trailer, premiering on Netflix, was a success, reaching No. 1 on viewing charts and causing temporary site outages due to millions of gamers trying...
summary.zh: 随着Rockstar的重磅大作即将占据头条，主流媒体应该停止将电子游戏视为需要解释的新奇事物。《侠盗猎车手VI》的预告片在Netflix上首播便大获成功，登上观看榜榜首，并因数百万游戏玩家试图观看而导致网站一度瘫痪。超过9000名Twitch主播进行了直播，观看时长超过520万小时。

body.en: As Rockstar’s blockbuster prepares to dominate the headlines, it’s time for the mainstream media to stop treating video games as a novelty that needs explaining Predictably, the Grand Theft Auto VI “extended look” which premiered on Netflix last week was a success for all involved. The 30-minute preview scorched to No 1 on the viewing chart and even brought the site down for a few minutes as millions of gamers tried to watch what was, effectively, a very long teaser trailer. According to data collated by Eurogamer , more than 9,000 Twitch streamers covered the show leading to 5,227,798 hours of viewing there alone. And this was just the beginning of what will surely be two months of escalating hype – and unprecedented media attention. Call me cynical, but I suspect the coverage of GTA VI in the media over the next few weeks will follow a familiar pattern. Mostly, it will be five-minute slots wedged in near the end of news bulletins in which games journalists, industry analysts and other pundits will be asked why the game is such a big deal, how much it cost to make and how much revenue it will generate. Perhaps a few will try to reignite the hoary old “violence in video games” debate, there will be presenters laughingly admitting they’ve not touched a game since Pac-Man, rolling their eyes and wallowing in their ignorance, in a way they never would while discussing any other art form. Somebody will venture the subversive view that “games are no longer just for kids”; somebody else will say “games make more money than films and music put together”. And that will be that, job done for another decade … or until there’s a funny story about Pokémon. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着 Rockstar 的大片准备占据头条新闻，主流媒体是时候停止将视频游戏视为需要解释的新奇事物了。可以预见的是，上周在 Netflix 上首映的侠盗猎车手 VI“扩展版外观”对所有参与者来说都是成功的。 30 分钟的预告片在收视率排行榜上名列第一，甚至导致网站瘫痪了几分钟，因为数以百万计的游戏玩家试图观看实际上很长的预告片。根据 Eurogamer 整理的数据，超过 9,000 名 Twitch 主播报道了该节目，仅该节目的观看时长就达到了 5,227,798 小时。而这只是接下来两个月不断升级的炒作和前所未有的媒体关注的开始。你可以说我很愤世嫉俗，但我怀疑未来几周媒体对 GTA VI 的报道将遵循熟悉的模式。大多数情况下，这将是新闻公告接近尾声时插入的五分钟时段，其中游戏记者、行业分析师和其他专家将被问到为什么这款游戏如此重要，制作成本是多少以及将产生多少收入。也许有些人会试图重新点燃古老的“电子游戏中的暴力”争论，会有主持人笑着承认自《吃豆人》之后他们就没有接触过游戏，翻白眼，沉浸在自己的无知中，以一种他们在讨论任何其他艺术形式时从未接触过的方式。有人会提出颠覆性的观点：“游戏不再只是孩子的专利”；有人会说“游戏比电影和音乐加起来更赚钱”。就这样，工作又完成了十年……或者直到出现一个关于神奇宝贝的有趣故事。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sheer scale of engagement with the Grand Theft Auto VI trailer, drawing millions of viewers and overwhelming streaming platforms, speaks to the accelerating pace of information and technological reach in our era. Daniel's prophecy foretold a time when 'knowledge would increase,' and the digital world's capacity to disseminate and consume content at such...
reflection.zh: 《侠盗猎车手VI》预告片引发的巨大关注，吸引了数百万观众并压垮了流媒体平台，这体现了我们这个时代信息和技术传播速度的加快。但以理书预言了一个“知识增长”的时代，而数字世界以如此快的速度传播和消费内容的能力，正是对这一古老预言的惊人现代体现。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Criminals publish data of 8.7m people after airports hack
title.zh: 罪犯在机场被黑客攻击后发布了 870 万人的数据

summary.en: The company, which owns Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands airports, was hacked last month. Criminal hackers have posted the personal data of nearly nine million people online after breaching three UK airports. The hackers extorted Manchester Airports Group (MAG) for an undisclosed amount but failed to get their...
summary.zh: 该公司拥有曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰兹机场，上个月遭到黑客攻击。在入侵了英国三家机场后，犯罪黑客在网上发布了近九百万人的个人数据。黑客向曼彻斯特机场集团（MAG）勒索了未披露的金额，但未能收到赎金。由于数据现在可供其他罪犯使用，客户被警告要防范二次攻击。

body.en:
Criminal hackers have posted the personal data of nearly nine million people online after breaching three UK airports .

Hackers extorted Manchester Airports Group (MAG) for an undisclosed amount but failed to get their ransom paid.

Customers of Manchester, London Stansted and East Midlands airports are being warned of secondary attacks as the data is now available to other criminals.

"MAG is confident that we have taken effective measures to protect our customers and we have contacted all those affected, including reaching out to all those with upcoming bookings to advise them of additional support," the company said in a statement.

Contact details, vehicle registrations and postcodes were stolen in the breach that appears to have accessed databases containing wi-fi log in and car parking details.

The cyber-crime group - which the BBC is not naming - is offering the entire data set for free to other criminals or scammers through their website.

"Half a terabyte, and every byte of it is pure PII [personally identifiable information]."

Stolen data experts at HaveIBeenPwned have analysed the published material and confirmed it contains people's email addresses, phone numbers, addresses, licence plate numbers, purchasing history and browsing device data.

Cyber-security expert Kevin Beaumont warned those affected to be on high alert for other forms of scam and hack - especially high profile or wealthy individuals.

"The data includes both historical locations and planned future travel, so individuals sensitive to their movements being known may need to take precautions," he said.

"People should be alert to scammers reusing the data and so knowing details such as phone numbers and car registration numbers," he added.

Law enforcement organisations including the UK's National Crime Agency have long advised victims of extortion attacks not to pay criminal ransoms as it fuels the hacker ecosystem.

MAG says it is working with the authorities and specialist advisors and says passengers' physical safety has not be at risk in the airports.

Unusually, the cyber criminals' website where the MAG data is available is hosted on the clear internet and not on the dark net like most other so-called hacker "leak sites".

This makes the data easier to access, increasing the risk to victims of MAG and the other companies the gang has breached in recent months.

As well as posting the stolen data, the hackers boasted about how they breached each victim using the same method each time - exploiting weaknesses in how companies store their digital keys for internal networks.

Data watchdog the Information Commissioner's Office has advice on its website , external for people whose data has been hacked. It includes:
